1	"""RFQ-to-bid: a team of model-directed agents, one per website, and a deterministic calculator.
2	
3	1. The model reads the brief: which tender, which date, which senders the rules authorize.
4	2. One agent per website explores it in its own browser. Each decides where to go, what to search for and which
5	   pages are evidence, and files those pages. A model call turns every filed page into structured facts in the
6	   shared case file; the open questions derived from the brief's rules tell all agents what is still missing, so a
7	   fact found on one website (a catalogue group, a key) steers the search on another.
8	3. `calculator.py` applies the bid rules to the facts: arithmetic only.
9	4. An agent enters the bid in the tender portal, has the mail agent fetch the signing TAN, and submits.
10	"""
11	from __future__ import annotations
12	
13	import asyncio
14	import json
15	import os
16	import sys
17	import time
18	
19	from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
20	
21	import browsers
22	import llm
23	import run as contract
24	from browser_env import Tab
25	from calculator import calculate_bid
26	import sanity
27	import validate
28	from casefile import SHAPES, CaseFile, read_context
29	from worker import ACTIONS_HELP, Agent
30	
31	RESTART_MIN_SECONDS = 120  # an unfinished agent is restarted only while this much investigation time is left
32	
33	INVESTIGATOR = """You are one of several research agents preparing a tender bid for a manufacturer's sales
34	engineering team. Each agent works a different website at the same time; you work the website "{site}" at {url}
35	in your own browser tab. Together you must find every fact the bid rules need. You only find and file evidence:
36	you never calculate prices.
37	
38	TASK BRIEF (the rules are authoritative)
39	{brief}
40	END OF BRIEF
41	
42	{actions}
43	Case-file actions:
44	  {{"do": "keep", "kind": "<kind>", "note": "<what it is>"}}
45	      File the document in front of you (the current page, or the document you just collected or fetched) as
46	      evidence. Its facts are then extracted into the shared case file and reported back to you. Kinds:
47	        positions         the tender's bill of quantities
48	        clarifications    answers of the tender's bidder Q&A
49	        revisions         the revision history of the buyer's technical specification
50	        requirements      the requirement details of one specification revision
51	        material          ERP master data of materials: technical attributes, status, planning, stock
52	        price_conditions  ERP price conditions of one material: validity, currency, quantity scales
53	        mail              an opened mail message
54	  {{"do": "answer", "question": "<id>", "status": "complete" | "absent", "note": "..."}}
55	      Close an open question: "complete" when all its evidence is filed (needed for lists that only you know to be
56	      complete), "absent" when you searched properly and what is asked for does not exist.
57	
58	How to work
59	- Every turn starts with the case file and the OPEN QUESTIONS. Work on the questions your website can answer;
60	  the other agents handle the rest. Facts they file show up in the case file and can open new questions for you.
61	- The OPEN QUESTIONS shown to you are the work assigned to your website. Do not search for another website's
62	  records. If none are open, finish with done; the coordinator will call you again when your website gets new work.
63	- You remember only the page in front of you: file a relevant page with keep BEFORE you leave it. keep files the
64	  whole document, also what was cut from your view. File a document once, with the right kind. Facts on a page only
65	  enter the CASE FILE when you call keep on that page; reading a value in your thought without calling keep leaves
66	  the case file unchanged.
67	- File pages that state the facts themselves (an opened document, record or message), not menus or hit lists.
68	  For a paged list or document that matters, use collect so that no page is missed, then keep it. For stock
69	  availability, drill down from plant/physical summaries into storage locations to view freely available
70	  (unrestricted) stock excluding blocked/inspection stock, and file that page with keep.
71	- The websites hold traps: superseded revisions, look-alike records for other tender references, drafts and
72	  previews, blocked materials, future-dated records, values in the wrong unit or number format. Check dates,
73	  references, senders and status marks before you rely on a record, and follow the brief's rules on which one
74	  counts. When in doubt, file both and let the facts decide.
75	- Do not reject a candidate record yourself (for example a material whose stroke seems to differ): file every
76	  candidate the question names with keep. The case file matches them against the requirement values, which can still
77	  change when amendments or reserves are filed.
78	- Follow the search hints a website gives. If a search returns nothing or too much, change the search terms.
79	- When a question asks for every item in a list, inspect its page controls and use collect on the control that
80	  advances that list before filing it. Check the resulting page count or end state; do not mark a list complete after
81	  seeing only its first page. If the list is inside an embedded document, use the controls belonging to that document.
82	- For mailbox questions, search relevant folders separately when mailbox search covers only the current folder;
83	  include the archive when looking for historical or latest records. If a query is too broad or returns nothing,
84	  refine the terms and try again. Open candidate messages and file the message itself, not only its hit row.
85	- If the news says extraction failed or found no usable records, do not mark that question complete. Reopen the
86	  evidence page, check that it contains the records requested, and file it again with the right kind.
87	- When no open question is left that your website can answer right now, finish with done, also when you need
88	  facts the other agents have not filed yet. You are called again as soon as the case file brings new questions.
89	  Never idle with wait and never browse around to pass the time.
90	"""
91	
92	
93	class Team:
94	    """Holds an agent that has nothing to do until the case file brings news, and ends the investigation when every
95	    agent is idle and no filed document is still being read."""
96	
97	    def __init__(self, case: CaseFile, names: list[str], deadline: float):
98	        self.case, self.names, self.deadline = case, set(names), deadline
99	        self.idle: set[str] = set()
100	        self.finished = asyncio.Event()
101	        self.woken: dict[str, float] = {}  # when an agent was last woken for finished reading (at most every 30 s)
102	
103	    def release(self, name: str, candidates: set[str]) -> None:
104	        """A routed agent (ERP or mail) went idle leaving `candidates` open and nothing is being read any more: those
105	        go to every agent (RELEASED), and the others are woken by a case-file change. Questions that turn up while it
106	        is idle are its own work (it is woken for them), so only the ones open when it went idle are candidates."""
107	        if self.case.pending or site_role(name) is None:
108	            return
109	        still = {qid for qid, _ in self.case.questions()} & candidates
110	        fresh = still - RELEASED
111	        if fresh:
112	            RELEASED.update(fresh)
113	            print(f"[{name}] left open, now offered to every agent: {', '.join(sorted(fresh))}", flush=True)
114	            bump = getattr(self.case, "_bump", None)
115	            if bump:
116	                bump()
117	
118	    def hook(self, name: str):
119	        async def hold(why: str) -> str | None:
120	            before = {qid for qid, _ in questions_for_site(name, self.case.questions())}
121	            self.release(name, before)
122	            version = self.case.version
123	            # Documents still being read when the agent went idle: once one of them is done, the agent is woken if
124	            # questions are still open. Sandbox run 024bd2ac: the ERP agent went idle "until the requirements are
125	            # read" with its material questions already open; they were never new, so it slept for 400 s.
126	            reading = self.case.pending
127	            self.idle.add(name)
128	            try:
129	                while not self.finished.is_set() and time.time() < self.deadline:
130	                    changed = await self.case.wait_change(version, 1.0)
131	                    if self.finished.is_set():
132	                        break
133	                    if changed:
134	                        self.release(name, before)
135	                        version = self.case.version
136	                        fresh = {qid for qid, _ in questions_for_site(name, self.case.questions())} - before
137	                        if fresh or self.case.news.get(name):
138	                            return "The case file has news" + (f"; new open questions: {', '.join(sorted(fresh))}" if fresh else "") + "."
139	                        still_open = {qid for qid, _ in questions_for_site(name, self.case.questions())}
140	                        rested = time.time() - self.woken.get(name, 0.0) >= 30
141	                        if reading and self.case.pending < reading and still_open and rested:
142	                            self.woken[name] = time.time()
143	                            return ("Documents that were still being read are now in the case file. Open questions: "
144	                                    f"{', '.join(sorted(still_open))}. Work on those your website can answer.")
145	                    elif self.idle == self.names and self.case.pending == 0:
146	                        self.finished.set()
147	                return None
148	            finally:
149	                self.idle.discard(name)
150	        return hold
151	
152	
153	def investigator(case: CaseFile, team: Team, tab: Tab, deadline: float) -> Agent:
154	    name = tab.site_id
155	    system = INVESTIGATOR.format(site=name, url=tab.base_url, brief=case.brief, actions=ACTIONS_HELP)
156	
157	    def briefing() -> str:
158	        questions = questions_for_site(name, case.questions())
159	        news = case.take_news(name)
160	        text = f"CASE FILE\n{case.status()}\n\nOPEN QUESTIONS\n"
161	        text += "\n".join(f"- [{qid}] {question}" for qid, question in questions) or "(none)"
162	        if news:
163	            text += "\n\nNEWS FROM YOUR FILED DOCUMENTS\n" + "\n".join(f"- {item}" for item in news)
164	        own_pending = case.pending_for(name)
165	        if own_pending:
166	            text += f"\n\n({own_pending} filed document(s) are still being read.)"
167	        elif case.pending:
168	            text += f"\n\n({case.pending} document(s) filed by other agents are still being read.)"
169	        return text
170	
171	    agent: Agent
172	
173	    async def keep(action: dict) -> str:
174	        document, source = agent.document()
175	        res = case.file(str(action.get("kind", "")), document, source, name)
176	        if res.startswith("this document is already filed"):
177	            res += "; do not file this same page again — check OPEN QUESTIONS for what is missing on another page, or finish with done"
178	        return res
179	
180	    async def answer(action: dict) -> str:
181	        # A completion action can arrive in the same turn as `keep`. Wait for this agent's own
182	        # extraction result (up to 45 s) instead of blocking on slow extractions from other websites.
183	        wait_until = min(deadline, time.time() + 45.0)
184	        while case.pending_for(name) and time.time() < wait_until:
185	            version = case.version
186	            if case.pending_for(name):
187	                await case.wait_change(version, min(1.0, max(0.0, wait_until - time.time())))
188	        if case.pending_for(name):
189	            return "Evidence extraction is still pending and the investigation deadline is near; do not repeat this answer action."
190	        return case.answer(str(action.get("question", "")).strip("[] "), str(action.get("status", "")), str(action.get("note", "")), agent=name)
191	
192	    # Navigation runs without the model's thinking: about twice as fast. The facts themselves are read by the
193	    # extraction calls in casefile.py, which keep thinking on. AGENT_THINK=1 turns it back on for comparison.
194	    agent = Agent(name, tab, system, briefing, extra={"keep": keep, "answer": answer}, deadline=deadline,
195	                  max_steps=int(os.environ.get("AGENT_MAX_STEPS", "150")), idle=team.hook(name),
196	                  think=os.environ.get("AGENT_THINK") == "1",
197	                  circle_hint="You are going in circles: the same thought keeps coming back without progress. If a "
198	                              "link or control does nothing, do not click it again: open its address directly with "
199	                              "goto, or use the search form on the page. If the "
200	                              "page in front of you is a candidate record, file it with keep now, also when it seems "
201	                              "not to match: the case file does the matching, and requirement values can still change "
202	                              "when amendments or reserves are filed. If you need facts the other agents have not "
203	                              "filed yet, finish with done; you are called again when the case file has news.")
204	    return agent
205	
206	
207	# Which website plays which role in this run, as the model read it from the brief (solve). The private dataset uses
208	# other site names, so routing goes by role first and falls back to the public site names only without one.
209	SITE_ROLES: dict[str, str] = {}
210	# Routed questions their own agent left open after it finished, with nothing still being read: offered to every agent
211	# from then on. The routing assumes the public split of facts (materials in the ERP, keys and approvals in the mail);
212	# the private dataset may split them differently, and a routed question must not end up with nobody to answer it.
213	RELEASED: set[str] = set()
214	
215	
216	def site_role(site_id: str) -> str | None:
217	    """"erp" or "mail" for the agent whose questions are routed, None for one that sees every question."""
218	    site = site_id.casefold()
219	    for role in ("erp", "mail"):
220	        named = (SITE_ROLES.get(role) or "").casefold()
221	        if (site == named) if named else (role in site):
222	            return role
223	    return None
224	
225	
226	def questions_for_site(site_id: str, questions: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
227	    """Keep specialized mail and ERP agents on questions their portal can resolve (from Vamshidhar's v1 package,
228	    sandbox run 44a626ef: 100 in 9.6 min, every agent finished by itself)."""
229	    site = site_id.casefold()
230	
231	    def plays(role: str) -> bool:
232	        named = (SITE_ROLES.get(role) or "").casefold()
233	        return site == named if named else role in site
234	
235	    if plays("erp"):
236	        prefixes = ("material:", "data:")
237	        return [(qid, text) for qid, text in questions if qid.startswith(prefixes) or qid in RELEASED]
238	    if plays("mail"):
239	        prefixes = ("condition_group:", "packaging_tariff:", "delivery_commitment:", "setup_pool:",
240	                    "project_bonus:", "index:", "fx:", "reserve:")
241	        return [(qid, text) for qid, text in questions
242	                if qid in ("mailbox", "discount") or qid.startswith(prefixes) or qid in RELEASED]
243	    return questions
244	
245	
246	async def open_tabs(playwright, sites: list[dict]) -> tuple[list, dict[str, Tab]]:
247	    """One tab per website: a browser each while the run has enough of them, else further tabs in the last one."""
248	    count = max(1, len(browsers.cdp_urls()) or min(len(sites), 4))
249	    opened, tabs, pages = [], {}, []
250	    for number in range(min(count, len(sites))):
251	        browser, page = await browsers.connect(playwright, number)
252	        opened.append(browser)
253	        pages.append(page)
254	    for index, site in enumerate(sites):
255	        page = pages[index] if index < len(pages) else await pages[-1].context.new_page()
256	        tabs[site["siteId"]] = Tab(page, site)
257	    for tab in tabs.values():  # where a tab may move when its own browser cannot load its website (Tab.renew)
258	        tab.spares = [page.context for page in pages if page.context is not tab.page.context]
259	    return opened, tabs
260	
261	
262	async def solve(task: dict, playwright) -> dict | None:
263	    started = time.time()
264	    sites = [site for site in task.get("access") or [] if isinstance(site, dict) and site.get("siteId") and site.get("url")]
265	    only = {name for name in os.environ.get("AGENT_SITES", "").split(",") if name}
266	    if not sites or not task.get("brief"):
267	        return None
268	    brief = task["brief"]
269	    listing = "\n".join(f"- {site['siteId']}: {site['url']}" for site in sites)
270	    context = await read_context(brief + f"\n\nThe websites of this run:\n{listing}")
271	    SITE_ROLES.clear()
272	    RELEASED.clear()
273	    SITE_ROLES.update({role: str(context.get(f"{role}_site") or "") for role in ("erp", "mail")
274	                       if str(context.get(f"{role}_site") or "") in {site["siteId"] for site in sites}})
275	    case = CaseFile(brief, context)
276	    print(f"Sanity checks on: {', '.join(sanity.active()) or 'none'}", flush=True)
277	    print(f"Context: tender {case.reference}, scenario {case.scenario.isoformat()}, company {case.company}, "
278	          f"senders {case.senders}", flush=True)
279	
280	    left = contract.seconds_left(task)
281	    budget = min(left, 20 * 60) if left != float("inf") else 20 * 60  # a scored run has 20 minutes
282	    hard_stop = started + budget - 45
283	    # The bid form takes ~2 min and the signing code another 1-2 min; a signed partial bid scores, an unsigned
284	    # complete one does not. So the investigation ends with 8 minutes left (sandbox test run 54c78c38: 330 s was
285	    # too little and the run ended unsigned).
286	    submit_reserve = min(480, budget * 0.4)
287	    investigate_until = hard_stop - submit_reserve
288	
289	    opened, tabs = await open_tabs(playwright, sites)
290	    try:
291	        working = [tab for name, tab in tabs.items() if not only or name in only]
292	        team = Team(case, [tab.site_id for tab in working], investigate_until)
293	        async def bounded(tab):  # an agent stuck past the deadline is stopped so that the others' facts still count
294	            restarted = False
295	            while True:
296	                limit = max(10.0, investigate_until - time.time() + 20)
297	                try:
298	                    outcome = await asyncio.wait_for(investigator(case, team, tab, investigate_until).run(), limit)
299	                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
300	                    team.finished.set()
301	                    return RuntimeError(f"stopped after {limit:.0f} s: still busy at the investigation deadline")
302	                # Weak sandbox runs (10, 22.8, 27.8, 29.1) had agents end with done: false while time was left. One
303	                # fresh start, with a clean conversation in a new tab, instead of giving the site up (sanity.py).
304	                if (sanity.enabled("agent_restart") and not restarted and not outcome.get("done")

"""RFQ-to-bid: a team of model-directed agents, one per website, and a deterministic calculator.

1. The model reads the brief: which tender, which date, which senders the rules authorize.
2. One agent per website explores it in its own browser. Each decides where to go, what to search for and which
   pages are evidence, and files those pages. A model call turns every filed page into structured facts in the
   shared case file; the open questions derived from the brief's rules tell all agents what is still missing, so a
   fact found on one website (a catalogue group, a key) steers the search on another.
3. `calculator.py` applies the bid rules to the facts: arithmetic only.
4. An agent enters the bid in the tender portal, has the mail agent fetch the signing TAN, and submits.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import os
import sys
import time

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

import browsers
import llm
import run as contract
from browser_env import Tab
from calculator import calculate_bid
import sanity
import validate
from casefile import SHAPES, CaseFile, read_context
from worker import ACTIONS_HELP, Agent

RESTART_MIN_SECONDS = 120  # an unfinished agent is restarted only while this much investigation time is left

INVESTIGATOR = """You are one of several research agents preparing a tender bid for a manufacturer's sales
engineering team. Each agent works a different website at the same time; you work the website "{site}" at {url}
in your own browser tab. Together you must find every fact the bid rules need. You only find and file evidence:
you never calculate prices.

TASK BRIEF (the rules are authoritative)
{brief}
END OF BRIEF

{actions}
Case-file actions:
  {{"do": "keep", "kind": "<kind>", "note": "<what it is>"}}
      File the document in front of you (the current page, or the document you just collected or fetched) as
      evidence. Its facts are then extracted into the shared case file and reported back to you. Kinds:
        positions         the tender's bill of quantities
        clarifications    answers of the tender's bidder Q&A
        revisions         the revision history of the buyer's technical specification
        requirements      the requirement details of one specification revision
        material          ERP master data of materials: technical attributes, status, planning, stock
        price_conditions  ERP price conditions of one material: validity, currency, quantity scales
        mail              an opened mail message
  {{"do": "answer", "question": "<id>", "status": "complete" | "absent", "note": "..."}}
      Close an open question: "complete" when all its evidence is filed (needed for lists that only you know to be
      complete), "absent" when you searched properly and what is asked for does not exist.

How to work
- Every turn starts with the case file and the OPEN QUESTIONS. Work on the questions your website can answer;
  the other agents handle the rest. Facts they file show up in the case file and can open new questions for you.
- The OPEN QUESTIONS shown to you are the work assigned to your website. Do not search for another website's
  records. If none are open, finish with done; the coordinator will call you again when your website gets new work.
- You remember only the page in front of you: file a relevant page with keep BEFORE you leave it. keep files the
  whole document, also what was cut from your view. File a document once, with the right kind. Facts on a page only
  enter the CASE FILE when you call keep on that page; reading a value in your thought without calling keep leaves
  the case file unchanged.
- File pages that state the facts themselves (an opened document, record or message), not menus or hit lists.
  For a paged list or document that matters, use collect so that no page is missed, then keep it. For stock
  availability, drill down from plant/physical summaries into storage locations to view freely available
  (unrestricted) stock excluding blocked/inspection stock, and file that page with keep.
- The websites hold traps: superseded revisions, look-alike records for other tender references, drafts and
  previews, blocked materials, future-dated records, values in the wrong unit or number format. Check dates,
  references, senders and status marks before you rely on a record, and follow the brief's rules on which one
  counts. When in doubt, file both and let the facts decide.
- Do not reject a candidate record yourself (for example a material whose stroke seems to differ): file every
  candidate the question names with keep. The case file matches them against the requirement values, which can still
  change when amendments or reserves are filed.
- Follow the search hints a website gives. If a search returns nothing or too much, change the search terms.
- When a question asks for every item in a list, inspect its page controls and use collect on the control that
  advances that list before filing it. Check the resulting page count or end state; do not mark a list complete after
  seeing only its first page. If the list is inside an embedded document, use the controls belonging to that document.
- For mailbox questions, search relevant folders separately when mailbox search covers only the current folder;
  include the archive when looking for historical or latest records. If a query is too broad or returns nothing,
  refine the terms and try again. Open candidate messages and file the message itself, not only its hit row.
- If the news says extraction failed or found no usable records, do not mark that question complete. Reopen the
  evidence page, check that it contains the records requested, and file it again with the right kind.
- When no open question is left that your website can answer right now, finish with done, also when you need
  facts the other agents have not filed yet. You are called again as soon as the case file brings new questions.
  Never idle with wait and never browse around to pass the time.
"""


class Team:
    """Holds an agent that has nothing to do until the case file brings news, and ends the investigation when every
    agent is idle and no filed document is still being read."""

    def __init__(self, case: CaseFile, names: list[str], deadline: float):
        self.case, self.names, self.deadline = case, set(names), deadline
        self.idle: set[str] = set()
        self.finished = asyncio.Event()
        self.woken: dict[str, float] = {}  # when an agent was last woken for finished reading (at most every 30 s)

    def release(self, name: str, candidates: set[str]) -> None:
        """A routed agent (ERP or mail) went idle leaving `candidates` open and nothing is being read any more: those
        go to every agent (RELEASED), and the others are woken by a case-file change. Questions that turn up while it
        is idle are its own work (it is woken for them), so only the ones open when it went idle are candidates."""
        if self.case.pending or site_role(name) is None:
            return
        still = {qid for qid, _ in self.case.questions()} & candidates
        fresh = still - RELEASED
        if fresh:
            RELEASED.update(fresh)
            print(f"[{name}] left open, now offered to every agent: {', '.join(sorted(fresh))}", flush=True)
            bump = getattr(self.case, "_bump", None)
            if bump:
                bump()

    def hook(self, name: str):
        async def hold(why: str) -> str | None:
            before = {qid for qid, _ in questions_for_site(name, self.case.questions())}
            self.release(name, before)
            version = self.case.version
            # Documents still being read when the agent went idle: once one of them is done, the agent is woken if
            # questions are still open. Sandbox run 024bd2ac: the ERP agent went idle "until the requirements are
            # read" with its material questions already open; they were never new, so it slept for 400 s.
            reading = self.case.pending
            self.idle.add(name)
            try:
                while not self.finished.is_set() and time.time() < self.deadline:
                    changed = await self.case.wait_change(version, 1.0)
                    if self.finished.is_set():
                        break
                    if changed:
                        self.release(name, before)
                        version = self.case.version
                        fresh = {qid for qid, _ in questions_for_site(name, self.case.questions())} - before
                        if fresh or self.case.news.get(name):
                            return "The case file has news" + (f"; new open questions: {', '.join(sorted(fresh))}" if fresh else "") + "."
                        still_open = {qid for qid, _ in questions_for_site(name, self.case.questions())}
                        rested = time.time() - self.woken.get(name, 0.0) >= 30
                        if reading and self.case.pending < reading and still_open and rested:
                            self.woken[name] = time.time()
                            return ("Documents that were still being read are now in the case file. Open questions: "
                                    f"{', '.join(sorted(still_open))}. Work on those your website can answer.")
                    elif self.idle == self.names and self.case.pending == 0:
                        self.finished.set()
                return None
            finally:
                self.idle.discard(name)
        return hold


def investigator(case: CaseFile, team: Team, tab: Tab, deadline: float) -> Agent:
    name = tab.site_id
    system = INVESTIGATOR.format(site=name, url=tab.base_url, brief=case.brief, actions=ACTIONS_HELP)

    def briefing() -> str:
        questions = questions_for_site(name, case.questions())
        news = case.take_news(name)
        text = f"CASE FILE\n{case.status()}\n\nOPEN QUESTIONS\n"
        text += "\n".join(f"- [{qid}] {question}" for qid, question in questions) or "(none)"
        if news:
            text += "\n\nNEWS FROM YOUR FILED DOCUMENTS\n" + "\n".join(f"- {item}" for item in news)
        own_pending = case.pending_for(name)
        if own_pending:
            text += f"\n\n({own_pending} filed document(s) are still being read.)"
        elif case.pending:
            text += f"\n\n({case.pending} document(s) filed by other agents are still being read.)"
        return text

    agent: Agent

    async def keep(action: dict) -> str:
        document, source = agent.document()
        res = case.file(str(action.get("kind", "")), document, source, name)
        if res.startswith("this document is already filed"):
            res += "; do not file this same page again — check OPEN QUESTIONS for what is missing on another page, or finish with done"
        return res

    async def answer(action: dict) -> str:
        # A completion action can arrive in the same turn as `keep`. Wait for this agent's own
        # extraction result (up to 45 s) instead of blocking on slow extractions from other websites.
        wait_until = min(deadline, time.time() + 45.0)
        while case.pending_for(name) and time.time() < wait_until:
            version = case.version
            if case.pending_for(name):
                await case.wait_change(version, min(1.0, max(0.0, wait_until - time.time())))
        if case.pending_for(name):
            return "Evidence extraction is still pending and the investigation deadline is near; do not repeat this answer action."
        return case.answer(str(action.get("question", "")).strip("[] "), str(action.get("status", "")), str(action.get("note", "")), agent=name)

    # Navigation runs without the model's thinking: about twice as fast. The facts themselves are read by the
    # extraction calls in casefile.py, which keep thinking on. AGENT_THINK=1 turns it back on for comparison.
    agent = Agent(name, tab, system, briefing, extra={"keep": keep, "answer": answer}, deadline=deadline,
                  max_steps=int(os.environ.get("AGENT_MAX_STEPS", "150")), idle=team.hook(name),
                  think=os.environ.get("AGENT_THINK") == "1",
                  circle_hint="You are going in circles: the same thought keeps coming back without progress. If a "
                              "link or control does nothing, do not click it again: open its address directly with "
                              "goto, or use the search form on the page. If the "
                              "page in front of you is a candidate record, file it with keep now, also when it seems "
                              "not to match: the case file does the matching, and requirement values can still change "
                              "when amendments or reserves are filed. If you need facts the other agents have not "
                              "filed yet, finish with done; you are called again when the case file has news.")
    return agent


# Which website plays which role in this run, as the model read it from the brief (solve). The private dataset uses
# other site names, so routing goes by role first and falls back to the public site names only without one.
SITE_ROLES: dict[str, str] = {}
# Routed questions their own agent left open after it finished, with nothing still being read: offered to every agent
# from then on. The routing assumes the public split of facts (materials in the ERP, keys and approvals in the mail);
# the private dataset may split them differently, and a routed question must not end up with nobody to answer it.
RELEASED: set[str] = set()


def site_role(site_id: str) -> str | None:
    """"erp" or "mail" for the agent whose questions are routed, None for one that sees every question."""
    site = site_id.casefold()
    for role in ("erp", "mail"):
        named = (SITE_ROLES.get(role) or "").casefold()
        if (site == named) if named else (role in site):
            return role
    return None


def questions_for_site(site_id: str, questions: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """Keep specialized mail and ERP agents on questions their portal can resolve (from Vamshidhar's v1 package,
    sandbox run 44a626ef: 100 in 9.6 min, every agent finished by itself)."""
    site = site_id.casefold()

    def plays(role: str) -> bool:
        named = (SITE_ROLES.get(role) or "").casefold()
        return site == named if named else role in site

    if plays("erp"):
        prefixes = ("material:", "data:")
        return [(qid, text) for qid, text in questions if qid.startswith(prefixes) or qid in RELEASED]
    if plays("mail"):
        prefixes = ("condition_group:", "packaging_tariff:", "delivery_commitment:", "setup_pool:",
                    "project_bonus:", "index:", "fx:", "reserve:")
        return [(qid, text) for qid, text in questions
                if qid in ("mailbox", "discount") or qid.startswith(prefixes) or qid in RELEASED]
    return questions


async def open_tabs(playwright, sites: list[dict]) -> tuple[list, dict[str, Tab]]:
    """One tab per website: a browser each while the run has enough of them, else further tabs in the last one."""
    count = max(1, len(browsers.cdp_urls()) or min(len(sites), 4))
    opened, tabs, pages = [], {}, []
    for number in range(min(count, len(sites))):
        browser, page = await browsers.connect(playwright, number)
        opened.append(browser)
        pages.append(page)
    for index, site in enumerate(sites):
        page = pages[index] if index < len(pages) else await pages[-1].context.new_page()
        tabs[site["siteId"]] = Tab(page, site)
    for tab in tabs.values():  # where a tab may move when its own browser cannot load its website (Tab.renew)
        tab.spares = [page.context for page in pages if page.context is not tab.page.context]
    return opened, tabs


async def solve(task: dict, playwright) -> dict | None:
    started = time.time()
    sites = [site for site in task.get("access") or [] if isinstance(site, dict) and site.get("siteId") and site.get("url")]
    only = {name for name in os.environ.get("AGENT_SITES", "").split(",") if name}
    if not sites or not task.get("brief"):
        return None
    brief = task["brief"]
    listing = "\n".join(f"- {site['siteId']}: {site['url']}" for site in sites)
    context = await read_context(brief + f"\n\nThe websites of this run:\n{listing}")
    SITE_ROLES.clear()
    RELEASED.clear()
    SITE_ROLES.update({role: str(context.get(f"{role}_site") or "") for role in ("erp", "mail")
                       if str(context.get(f"{role}_site") or "") in {site["siteId"] for site in sites}})
    case = CaseFile(brief, context)
    print(f"Sanity checks on: {', '.join(sanity.active()) or 'none'}", flush=True)
    print(f"Context: tender {case.reference}, scenario {case.scenario.isoformat()}, company {case.company}, "
          f"senders {case.senders}", flush=True)

    left = contract.seconds_left(task)
    budget = min(left, 20 * 60) if left != float("inf") else 20 * 60  # a scored run has 20 minutes
    hard_stop = started + budget - 45
    # The bid form takes ~2 min and the signing code another 1-2 min; a signed partial bid scores, an unsigned
    # complete one does not. So the investigation ends with 8 minutes left (sandbox test run 54c78c38: 330 s was
    # too little and the run ended unsigned).
    submit_reserve = min(480, budget * 0.4)
    investigate_until = hard_stop - submit_reserve

    opened, tabs = await open_tabs(playwright, sites)
    try:
        working = [tab for name, tab in tabs.items() if not only or name in only]
        team = Team(case, [tab.site_id for tab in working], investigate_until)
        async def bounded(tab):  # an agent stuck past the deadline is stopped so that the others' facts still count
            restarted = False
            while True:
                limit = max(10.0, investigate_until - time.time() + 20)
                try:
                    outcome = await asyncio.wait_for(investigator(case, team, tab, investigate_until).run(), limit)
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    team.finished.set()
                    return RuntimeError(f"stopped after {limit:.0f} s: still busy at the investigation deadline")
                # Weak sandbox runs (10, 22.8, 27.8, 29.1) had agents end with done: false while time was left. One
                # fresh start, with a clean conversation in a new tab, instead of giving the site up (sanity.py).
                if (sanity.enabled("agent_restart") and not restarted and not outcome.get("done")
                        and investigate_until - time.time() > RESTART_MIN_SECONDS and case.questions()):
                    restarted = True
                    print(f"[{tab.site_id}] stopped unfinished after {outcome.get('steps')} steps; restarting once "
                          "in a fresh tab", flush=True)
                    try:
                        await asyncio.wait_for(tab.renew(), 45)
                    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
                        print(f"[{tab.site_id}] could not renew the tab: {str(error)[:150]}", flush=True)
                    continue
                return outcome
        outcomes = await asyncio.gather(*(bounded(tab) for tab in working), return_exceptions=True)
        for tab, outcome in zip(working, outcomes):
            print(f"[{tab.site_id}] finished: {outcome if isinstance(outcome, Exception) else json.dumps(outcome, ensure_ascii=False)[:300]}", flush=True)
        for _ in range(40):  # facts of the last filed documents
            if not case.pending:
                break
            await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

        facts = case.inputs()
        bid = calculate_bid(case.reference, case.scenario, facts.governing, facts.positions, facts.clarifications,
                            facts.requirements, facts.materials, facts.authorities, facts.no_material)
        issues = []
        if sanity.enabled("validator"):
            bid, issues = validate.check(bid, {p.position for p in facts.positions} or None)
        if issues:
            print("VALIDATOR: " + " | ".join(issues), flush=True)
        print(f"Investigation took {time.time() - started:.0f} s. {llm.summary()}", flush=True)
        print("CASE FILE\n" + case.status(), flush=True)
        print("OPEN QUESTIONS LEFT: " + (", ".join(qid for qid, _ in case.questions()) or "none"), flush=True)
        print("BID: " + json.dumps(bid.answer(), ensure_ascii=False) + f" omitted={bid.omitted} notes={bid.notes}", flush=True)
        if os.environ.get("AGENT_DUMP"):
            with open(os.environ["AGENT_DUMP"], "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
                handle.write(case.dump())
        if os.environ.get("AGENT_SKIP_SUBMIT") == "1":
            return bid.answer()

        submission = task.get("submission") or {}
        tender_tab = tabs.get(submission.get("siteId")) or next(
            (tab for tab in tabs.values() if submission.get("url", "").startswith(tab.base_url)), None)
        mail_tab = tabs.get(str(context.get("mail_site") or ""))
        if submission.get("kind") == "site" and tender_tab is not None:
            import submit
            receipt = await submit.submit_bid(
                tender_tab, mail_tab, bid,
                {"tender_reference": case.reference, "scenario_date": case.scenario.isoformat(), "company": case.company,
                 "vat_id": case.vat_id, "email": case.mailbox or ""}, brief, hard_stop)
            print(f"Submission: {json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False)[:600]}. Total {time.time() - started:.0f} s. {llm.summary()}", flush=True)
        return bid.answer()
    finally:
        for browser in opened:
            try:
                await browser.close()
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass


async def main() -> int:
    task, token = contract.load_run()
    print(f"Run {task.get('run_id')}: {len(task.get('access') or [])} site(s), {contract.seconds_left(task):.0f}s left.", flush=True)
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        answer = await solve(task, playwright)
    if not answer:
        print("No answer to submit; exiting cleanly.")
    elif (task.get("submission") or {}).get("kind") == "site":
        print(f"Answer worked out for the site: {json.dumps(answer)}")
    elif not token:
        print(f"Answer (local run, not submitted): {json.dumps(answer)}")
    else:
        status, body = contract.submit_answer(task, token, answer)
        print(f"Submitted answer -> HTTP {status}: {body}")
        return 0 if status < 300 else 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))

23	The actions run in order. Once an action loads another page the rest of the list is dropped, because the element
24	ids change with every page: chain actions only while you stay on the page (fill fields, tick boxes, then click).
25	Elements you can act on carry an id like [12].
26	
27	Browser actions:
28	  {"do": "login"}                                  enter this website's credentials in the login form shown and submit it
29	  {"do": "click", "id": 12}
30	  {"do": "fill", "id": 12, "text": "...", "enter": false}     type into a field; "enter": true also presses Enter
31	  {"do": "select", "id": 12, "value": "<an option's value or label>"}
32	  {"do": "set", "id": 12, "value": true}           tick/untick a checkbox, choose a radio button, or move a slider to a number
33	  {"do": "goto", "url": "<an address or path on this website that you have seen>"}
34	  {"do": "back"}    {"do": "reload"}
35	  {"do": "collect", "id": 12, "max_pages": 10}     [12] is the next-page or load-more control of a list or paged document you want in full: it is followed until the end and all pages come back as one document
36	  {"do": "fetch", "id": 12}                        download the file behind link [12] (archive, CSV, PDF, text) and read it as a document
37	  {"do": "wait"}                                   pause two seconds, for a page that is still loading
38	  {"do": "steps", "steps": [{"field": "<label>", "value": "..."}, {"press": "<button label>"}, ...]}
39	                                                   a sequence across page reloads: each step finds its control again
40	                                                   by its label on the page as it then is, so a whole chain (choose,
41	                                                   apply, choose the next, apply, fill, continue) runs in one turn.
42	                                                   "field" fills a text field, chooses in a list or ticks a box
43	                                                   (value true/false); "press" clicks a button or link. It stops at
44	                                                   the first step whose control it cannot find unambiguously and
45	                                                   tells you which steps ran. Use it for forms whose fields you know.
46	  {"do": "done", "summary": "<ten words>", "answer": "..."}   you are finished; "answer" only when you were asked for one
47	
48	Reading the page:
49	- It is rendered as a screen reader would read it. "(described: ...)" and "(tooltip: ...)" hold text that only
50	  shows on hover, "[canvas: ...]" what a drawing says, "(in collapsed menu)" an entry of a menu that is closed
51	  (you can click it all the same), "->" where a link leads, "{data-...}" attributes of a control.
52	- A "LOCKED AREA" is disabled until you pass the check in front of it. A page can hold several checks, one per
53	  area, also inside embedded frames further down: after passing one, look for the next LOCKED AREA and its own
54	  controls. A check whose status already reads as unlocked is done; setting it again changes nothing.
55	- A "toggle" opens or closes a section. If a section you opened stays empty after you unlocked it, click its toggle
56	  twice (close, then open) to load it again.
57	- Several controls can carry the same name while only one of them does the job: tell them apart by where they
58	  lead and what their attributes say.
59	- Popups, cookie walls, access checks, error pages and expired sessions happen. Deal with them and carry on;
60	  after a session expires, log in again. Surveys, tools and help pages lead away from your task.
61	"""

63	STEP_TIMEOUT = 45  # seconds for one page read or one browser action: a hung page must not freeze the whole run
64	# How many past turns stay word for word; older ones keep the reasoning and drop the page text. Each full turn resends
65	# a page of up to 14,000 characters on every call, and input tokens are most of the run's cost (the provider's prompt
66	# cache hits only now and then). FULL_TURNS=2 brings back the earlier setting for comparison.
67	FULL_TURNS = int(os.environ.get("FULL_TURNS", "1"))
68	NAVIGATING = {"click", "goto", "back", "reload", "login", "collect", "fetch", "steps"}
69	STEPS_LIMIT, STEPS_TIMEOUT = 30, 240  # one "steps" action: at most this many steps, and seconds in all
70	ALERT = re.compile(r"\((?:alert|status)\)[^\n]*")  # a message the page announces to screen readers (Tab.observe)
71	CONTROL = re.compile(r'\[(\d+)\] (?:\(in collapsed menu\) )?(select|input(?:\(\w+\))?|button|checkbox|radio|link|clickable|switch) "([^"]*)"([^\[]*)')

74	def find_control(page: str, label: str, kinds: tuple[str, ...]) -> tuple[str | None, str]:
75	    """The id of the one control of one of `kinds` labelled `label` on the rendered page: an exact label first,
76	    then a label that contains it. (None, why) when there is none or more than one that is not disabled."""
77	    wanted = " ".join(label.casefold().split())
78	    found = [(m.group(1), m.group(2), " ".join(m.group(3).casefold().split()), m.group(4)) for m in CONTROL.finditer(page)]
79	    found = [f for f in found if f[1].split("(")[0] in kinds and "disabled" not in f[3]]
80	    for match in ([f for f in found if f[2] == wanted], [f for f in found if wanted and wanted in f[2]]):
81	        ids = list(dict.fromkeys(f[0] for f in match))
82	        if len(ids) == 1:
83	            return ids[0], match[0][1]
84	        if len(ids) > 1:
85	            return None, f'{len(ids)} controls are labelled "{label}" ({", ".join("[" + i + "]" for i in ids)}): use their ids'
86	    return None, f'no control labelled "{label}" on the page now'

89	def state_fingerprint(observation: str) -> str:
90	    """A stable signature of the model-visible page state.
91	
92	    ``Tab.observe`` assigns fresh action ids on every read.  They are useful to
93	    the model, but must not make an unchanged page look like a successful
94	    action.  Removing only those generated ids keeps visible values, errors,
95	    dialogs and the URL in the comparison.
96	    """
97	    stable = re.sub(r"\[\d+\]", "[]", observation)
98	    return hashlib.sha1(stable.encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()
99

101	def action_fingerprint(actions: list[dict], observation: str = "") -> str:
102	    """Use a control's visible label instead of its transient id in repeat checks."""
103	    stable_actions = []
104	    for action in actions:
105	        stable = {key: value for key, value in action.items() if key != "id"}
106	        if action.get("id") is not None:
107	            match = re.search(rf"(?m)^\[{re.escape(str(action['id']))}\](.*)$", observation)
108	            if match:
109	                stable["target"] = match.group(1).strip()
110	        stable_actions.append(stable)
111	    return json.dumps(stable_actions, sort_keys=True)

116	class Agent:
117	    def __init__(self, name: str, tab: Tab, system: str, briefing: Callable[[], str],
118	                 extra: dict[str, Callable[[dict], Awaitable[str]]] | None = None, deadline: float | None = None,
119	                 max_steps: int = 80, think: bool = False,
120	                 idle: Callable[[str], Awaitable[str | None]] | None = None,
121	                 guard: Callable[[dict], str | None] | None = None, finish_on_repeat: int | None = None, circle_hint: str | None = None):
122	        """`briefing()` heads every turn. `extra` adds actions: name -> handler(action) -> result text.
123	        `idle("done")` lets the caller hold a finished agent until there is news for it (returns the news) or
124	        let it stop (returns None)."""
125	        self.name, self.tab, self.system, self.briefing = name, tab, system, briefing
126	        self.extra = extra or {}
127	        self.deadline = deadline or time.time() + 3600
128	        self.max_steps, self.think, self.idle = max_steps, think, idle
129	        self.guard = guard
130	        # An agent that states the same thought this many turns in a row has its answer and is only "verifying":
131	        # it gets one forced final turn instead of running out of time (stress test: the courier read the right code,
132	        # then re-verified it for 14 turns and ended with no answer).
133	        self.finish_on_repeat = finish_on_repeat
134	        self._thoughts: list[str] = []
135	        self._circle_hinted = False
136	        self._circle_hinted_at = -99
137	        self._circle_hints = 0
138	        self._escalate = False
139	        self.escalations = 0  # stronger turns given (escalation plugin), at most ESCALATION_LIMIT
140	        self._stuck = False
141	        self.circle_hint = circle_hint or (
142	            "You are going in circles: the same steps keep repeating without progress. The page may already show "
143	            "what you need, including inside embedded documents: read it fully. Otherwise open the link's address "
144	            "directly with goto, or try a different way. If you already have the answer, finish with done now.")
145	        self._circle_hint: str | None = None  # a sanity check that may veto a browser action before it runs (sanity.py)
146	        self.turns: list[dict] = []
147	        self.held: tuple[str, str] | None = None  # a collected or fetched document, until the agent moves on
148	        self.coverage = Ledger()  # what this agent really opened, typed and followed (coverage.py)
149	        self.steps = 0
150	        self.started = time.time()
151	
152	    def document(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
153	        """What the agent is looking at: the document it collected or fetched, else the page as last read."""
154	        return self.held or (self.tab.document, self.tab.document_source)
155	
156	    def log(self, text: str) -> None:
157	        print(f"[{self.name} {self.steps:02d} t+{time.time() - self.started:.0f}s] {text}", flush=True)
158	
159	    def _messages(self, user: str) -> list[dict]:
160	        messages = [{"role": "system", "content": self.system}]
161	        for index, turn in enumerate(self.turns):
162	            recent = index >= len(self.turns) - FULL_TURNS
163	            messages.append({"role": "user", "content": turn["user"] if recent else turn["short"]})
164	            messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": turn["assistant"]})
165	        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": user})
166	        return messages

168	    async def _escalated_turn(self, user: str) -> dict:
169	        """One stronger turn for an agent that keeps going in circles: reasoning on, and a screenshot of the page,
170	        which shows what the text view can hide (a slider, a disabled button, a banner over the page, a scanned
171	        document). The model still decides what to do; nothing about the website is assumed here."""
172	        text = (user + "\n\nYOU ARE STUCK: your last steps keep repeating without progress. Look at the screenshot of "
173	                "the page as it really is, think about why your steps did not work, and choose a different way. If "
174	                "what you need is not reachable from here, finish with done.")
175	        messages = self._messages(text)
176	        image = await self.tab.screenshot() if hasattr(self.tab, "screenshot") else None
177	        if image:
178	            messages[-1]["content"] = [{"type": "text", "text": text},
179	                                       {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": f"data:image/jpeg;base64,{image}"}}]
180	        self.log(f"escalated: reasoning on{', with a screenshot' if image else ', no screenshot available'}")
181	        reply = await llm.chat_json(messages, think=True, label=f"{self.name}:escalated")
182	        return reply or await llm.chat_json(self._messages(user), think=self.think, label=self.name)

184	    async def _steps(self, steps: list) -> str:
185	        """Runs a chain of label-addressed steps across page reloads (the "steps" action). Every step is turned into
186	        the plain action it stands for and passes the same guard as a fill, select, set or click the model sends."""
187	        done: list[str] = []
188	        for number, step in enumerate(steps[:STEPS_LIMIT], start=1):
189	            if not isinstance(step, dict):
190	                continue
191	            label = str(step.get("press") or step.get("field") or "")
192	            page = await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.observe(), STEP_TIMEOUT)
193	            if "press" in step:
194	                aid, kind = find_control(page, label, ("button", "link", "clickable"))
195	                action = {"do": "click", "id": aid}
196	            else:
197	                aid, kind = find_control(page, label, ("select", "input", "checkbox", "radio", "switch"))
198	                value = step.get("value", "")
199	                if kind == "select":
200	                    action = {"do": "select", "id": aid, "value": str(value)}
201	                elif kind in ("checkbox", "radio", "switch"):
202	                    action = {"do": "set", "id": aid, "value": value if isinstance(value, bool) else str(value).lower() not in ("false", "0", "no", "")}
203	                else:
204	                    action = {"do": "fill", "id": aid, "text": str(value)}
205	            if aid is None:
206	                return (f"ran {len(done)} of {len(steps)} steps" + (": " + "; ".join(done) if done else "") +
207	                        f". Stopped at step {number}: {kind}. The page is as it is now; continue from there.")
208	            veto = self.guard(action) if self.guard else None
209	            if veto:
210	                return f"ran {len(done)} of {len(steps)} steps" + (": " + "; ".join(done) if done else "") + f". Step {number} was refused: {veto}"
211	            alerts_before = set(ALERT.findall(page))
212	            result = await asyncio.wait_for(self._browser(action), STEP_TIMEOUT)
213	            done.append(f'{number}. {label}: {str(result)[:80]}')
214	            if action["do"] == "click":  # a press can bring an error message: stop there instead of filling on blindly
215	                after = await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.observe(), STEP_TIMEOUT)
216	                new = [a for a in ALERT.findall(after) if a not in alerts_before]
217	                if new:
218	                    return (f"ran {len(done)} of {len(steps)} steps: " + "; ".join(done) +
219	                            f". After step {number} the page says: {' / '.join(new)[:300]}. Fix that before going on.")
220	            if any(word in str(result) for word in ("has no option", "did not change", "is disabled", "BUT the field")):
221	                return f"ran {len(done)} of {len(steps)} steps: " + "; ".join(done) + f". Step {number} did not take; check it."
222	        return f"ran all {len(done)} steps: " + "; ".join(done)

224	    async def _browser(self, action: dict) -> str:
225	        do, tab = action.get("do"), self.tab
226	        if do == "login":
227	            return await tab.login()
228	        if do == "click":
229	            return await tab.click(action.get("id"))
230	        if do == "steps":
231	            return await self._steps(action.get("steps") or [])
232	        if do == "fill":
233	            return await tab.fill(action.get("id"), action.get("text", ""), bool(action.get("enter")))
234	        if do == "select":
235	            return await tab.select(action.get("id"), action.get("value", ""))
236	        if do == "set":
237	            return await tab.set(action.get("id"), action.get("value", True))
238	        if do == "goto":
239	            return await tab.goto(action.get("url", ""))
240	        if do == "back":
241	            return await tab.back()
242	        if do == "reload":
243	            return await tab.reload()
244	        if do == "collect":
245	            return await tab.collect(action.get("id"), action.get("max_pages") or 10)
246	        if do == "fetch":
247	            return await tab.fetch(action.get("id"))
248	        return f'unknown action "{do}"'

250	    def _may_close(self, action: dict) -> str | None:
251	        """An action that closes a question ({"question": ..., "status": "complete" | "absent"}) is checked against
252	        what the agent really did on its website, not against what it says it did. None lets the action run."""
253	        status = str(action.get("status", "")).strip().lower()
254	        if "question" not in action or status not in ("complete", "absent") or not sanity.enabled("coverage_gate"):
255	            return None
256	        return self.coverage.gate(str(action.get("question", "")).strip("[] "), status)

258	    async def _alive(self) -> bool:
259	        try:
260	            return bool(await self.tab.page.main_frame.evaluate("() => document.querySelectorAll('[data-aid]').length > 0"))
261	        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
262	            return False

264	    async def run(self) -> dict:
265	        results: list[str] = []
266	        outcome = {"done": False, "summary": "", "answer": None, "steps": 0}
267	        self.log(f"starting at {self.tab.base_url}")
268	        if self.tab.page.url in ("", "about:blank"):
269	            try:
270	                results.append(await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.goto(self.tab.base_url + "/"), STEP_TIMEOUT))
271	            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
272	                results.append(f"opening {self.tab.base_url} took longer than {STEP_TIMEOUT} s; reload or try again")
273	        repeats, last_signature, failures = 0, "", 0
274	        seen_signatures: dict[str, int] = {}
275	        stuck = 0  # page reads and navigations in a row that timed out or failed: the tab may be broken
276	        while self.steps < self.max_steps and time.time() < self.deadline:
277	            self.steps += 1
278	            clock = time.time()
279	            try:
280	                page = await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.observe(), STEP_TIMEOUT)
281	            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
282	                stuck += 1
283	                page = f"(the page did not finish loading within {STEP_TIMEOUT} s; reload it or go elsewhere)"
284	            except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
285	                page = f"(the page could not be read: {str(error)[:200]})"
286	            self.coverage.saw(page)
287	            results.extend(self.tab.take_events())
288	            done_text = "\n".join(f"{n}. {text}" for n, text in enumerate(results, 1)) or "(none yet)"
289	            left = int(self.deadline - time.time())
290	            user = (f"{self.briefing()}\n\nTIME LEFT: {left} s\n\nRESULTS OF YOUR LAST ACTIONS\n{done_text}\n\n"
291	                    f"CURRENT PAGE\n{page}")
292	            read_s = time.time() - clock
293	            clock = time.time()
294	            if self._escalate:
295	                self._escalate = False
296	                self.escalations += 1
297	                reply = await self._escalated_turn(user)
298	            else:
299	                reply = await llm.chat_json(self._messages(user), think=self.think, label=self.name)
300	            model_s = time.time() - clock
301	            clock = time.time()
302	            actions = reply.get("actions")
303	            if isinstance(actions, dict):
304	                actions = [actions]
305	            if not isinstance(actions, list) or not actions:
306	                if llm._warm.get("expired"):
307	                    self.log("run token expired (submission completed); stopping")
308	                    break
309	                failures += 1
310	                if failures >= 4:
311	                    self.log("the model gave no usable actions four times; stopping")
312	                    break
313	                results = ['your reply had no "actions" list; reply with {"thought": ..., "actions": [...]}']
314	                continue
315	            failures = 0
316	            thought = str(reply.get("thought", ""))[:300]
317	            self._thoughts.append(" ".join(thought.lower().split())[:160])
318	            recent = self._thoughts
319	            # Going in circles: the same thought three times (A A A), two thoughts alternating (A B A B), as in the
320	            # courier stress test where "unlock the list" and "open the newest message" alternated for 19 turns, or
321	            # the same thought three times within the last 16 turns, as in sandbox run e3804980 where the ERP agent
322	            # rejected the same material every 6 turns for 46 turns.
323	            strict = ((len(recent) >= 3 and len(set(recent[-3:])) == 1)
324	                      or (len(recent) >= 4 and recent[-1] == recent[-3] and recent[-2] == recent[-4] and recent[-1] != recent[-2]))
325	            circling = strict or recent[-16:].count(recent[-1]) >= 3
326	            if circling and (not self.finish_on_repeat or not self._circle_hinted):
327	                circling = False  # a concrete way out first; only an agent with finish_on_repeat is then forced to finish
328	                if len(recent) - self._circle_hinted_at >= 6:  # once every 6 turns at most
329	                    if self._circle_hints >= 2 and self.idle:
330	                        self._stuck = True  # two hints ignored: an investigator is sent idle (see below)
331	                    self._circle_hinted, self._circle_hinted_at = True, len(recent)
332	                    self._circle_hints += 1
333	                    self._circle_hint = self.circle_hint
334	                    # The second time: also one stronger turn, reasoning on and with a screenshot (sanity plugin
335	                    # "escalation"), before the agent is given up on at the third. Investigators only (they have an
336	                    # idle hook); the bid clerk, which repeats one pattern for every position on purpose (run bb0655a2), only on a
337	                    # strict loop: the same thought three times or two alternating (run d3ca14df: 95 turns of "fill,
338	                    # add position, empty again" until its step cap, never signed).
339	                    if self._circle_hints == 2 and (self.idle or strict) and self.escalations < ESCALATION_LIMIT \
340	                            and sanity.enabled("escalation"):
341	                        self._escalate = True
342	            if circling:
343	                final = await llm.chat_json(self._messages(
344	                    user + "\n\nYou have reached the same conclusion several times in a row. Stop checking and finish "
345	                    'NOW with exactly one action: {"do": "done", "summary": "...", "answer": "..."}, the answer being '
346	                    "the value you found (or no answer if you truly found none)."), think=False, label=self.name)
347	                done = next((a for a in (final.get("actions") or []) if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("do") == "done"), None)
348	                done = done or (final if final.get("do") == "done" else None)
349	                if done is not None:
350	                    self.log(f"forced to finish after going in circles: {json.dumps(done, ensure_ascii=False)[:200]}")
351	                    outcome.update(done=True, summary=str(done.get("summary", "")), answer=done.get("answer"))
352	                    break
353	            head = page.split("\n", 2)
354	            short = f"RESULTS OF YOUR LAST ACTIONS\n{done_text[:700]}\n\nPAGE (text dropped)\n" + "\n".join(head[:2])
355	            self.turns.append({"user": user, "short": short, "assistant": json.dumps(reply, ensure_ascii=False)})
356	            if os.environ.get("AGENT_TRACE"):  # what the agent saw and answered, one file per turn
357	                os.makedirs(os.environ["AGENT_TRACE"], exist_ok=True)
358	                with open(os.path.join(os.environ["AGENT_TRACE"], f"{self.name}_{self.steps:03d}.txt"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
359	                    handle.write(user + "\n\n===== REPLY =====\n" + json.dumps(reply, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
360	
361	            # A repeated action is a loop only if the model also sees the same
362	            # page.  A form may keep its URL while legitimately changing state.
363	            signature = action_fingerprint(actions, page) + state_fingerprint(page)
364	            seen_signatures[signature] = seen_signatures.get(signature, 0) + 1
365	            repeats = repeats + 1 if signature == last_signature else max(0, seen_signatures[signature] - 1)
366	            last_signature = signature
367	
368	            results, finished, moved = [], None, False
369	            if self._circle_hint:  # shown with the results of this turn's actions, at the top of the next turn
370	                results.append(self._circle_hint)
371	                self._circle_hint = None
372	            for action in actions[:8]:
373	                if not isinstance(action, dict):
374	                    continue
375	                do = action.get("do")
376	                if do == "done":
377	                    finished = action
378	                    break
379	                if do == "wait":
380	                    await asyncio.sleep(2)
381	                    results.append("waited two seconds")
382	                    continue
383	                if do in self.extra:
384	                    refusal = self._may_close(action)
385	                    if refusal:
386	                        results.append(refusal)
387	                        continue
388	                    try:
389	                        results.append(await self.extra[do](action))
390	                    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
391	                        results.append(f"{do} failed: {str(error)[:200]}")
392	                    continue
393	                if moved:
394	                    results.append(f'skipped {json.dumps(action, ensure_ascii=False)[:120]}: the page changed, its ids are stale')
395	                    continue
396	                veto = self.guard(action) if self.guard else None
397	                if veto:
398	                    results.append(veto)
399	                    continue
400	                before = self.tab.page.url
401	                try:
402	                    result = await asyncio.wait_for(self._browser(action), STEPS_TIMEOUT if do == "steps" else STEP_TIMEOUT)
403	                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
404	                    result = f"{do} took longer than {STEP_TIMEOUT} s and was stopped; the page may be stuck"
405	                except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
406	                    result = f"{do} failed: {str(error)[:200]}"
407	                results.append(result)
408	                if do == "fill" and NOT_KEPT not in str(result):  # a text the field refused was never searched
409	                    self.coverage.typed(before, action.get("text", ""))
410	                elif do == "collect":
411	                    self.coverage.followed(getattr(self.tab, "last_collect", None))
412	                # Do not trust a successful browser call by itself: enterprise
413	                # portals often swallow a click or reject a field silently.
414	                # The next model turn gets a compact, actionable state-delta
415	                # report rather than assuming the dispatch took effect.
416	                if do not in ("collect", "fetch"):
417	                    try:
418	                        after = await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.observe(), STEP_TIMEOUT)
419	                        changed = state_fingerprint(page) != state_fingerprint(after)
420	                        if changed:
421	                            self.coverage.moved()
422	                            results.append(f"verification: {do} visibly changed the page state")
423	                        else:
424	                            results.append(f"verification: {do} caused no visible page change; inspect the control "
425	                                           "or try a different recovery path instead of repeating it blindly")
426	                    except asyncio.TimeoutError:

428	                    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001

435	                elif do in NAVIGATING:

444	                except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001

447	            self.log(f"(read {read_s:.1f}s, model {model_s:.1f}s, act {time.time() - clock:.1f}s) {thought} | "
448	                     f"{json.dumps(actions, ensure_ascii=False)[:400]} | " + " ; ".join(r[:160] for r in results))

451	                               "here. Read the page again from the top for another way (a further check, a toggle, a "
452	                               "different link, a search), or finish with done.")
