"""The agent loop: a model reads a browser tab as text, decides what to do next, and acts.

One `Agent` drives one `Tab`. Each turn the model gets its briefing, what its last actions did and the current page,
and answers with a thought and a short list of actions. The loop only carries those out; where to go, what to
search for, which record matters and when the job is finished are the model's calls.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import time
from typing import Awaitable, Callable

import llm
import sanity
from browser_env import NOT_KEPT, Tab
from coverage import Ledger

ACTIONS_HELP = """Reply with ONE JSON object: {"thought": "<one or two short sentences: what the page tells you and what you do next>", "actions": [ ... ]}.
The actions run in order. Once an action loads another page the rest of the list is dropped, because the element
ids change with every page: chain actions only while you stay on the page (fill fields, tick boxes, then click).
Elements you can act on carry an id like [12].

Browser actions:
  {"do": "login"}                                  enter this website's credentials in the login form shown and submit it
  {"do": "click", "id": 12}
  {"do": "fill", "id": 12, "text": "...", "enter": false}     type into a field; "enter": true also presses Enter
  {"do": "select", "id": 12, "value": "<an option's value or label>"}
  {"do": "set", "id": 12, "value": true}           tick/untick a checkbox, choose a radio button, or move a slider to a number
  {"do": "goto", "url": "<an address or path on this website that you have seen>"}
  {"do": "back"}    {"do": "reload"}
  {"do": "collect", "id": 12, "max_pages": 10}     [12] is the next-page or load-more control of a list or paged document you want in full: it is followed until the end and all pages come back as one document
  {"do": "fetch", "id": 12}                        download the file behind link [12] (archive, CSV, PDF, text) and read it as a document
  {"do": "wait"}                                   pause two seconds, for a page that is still loading
  {"do": "steps", "steps": [{"field": "<label>", "value": "..."}, {"press": "<button label>"}, ...]}
                                                   a sequence across page reloads: each step finds its control again
                                                   by its label on the page as it then is, so a whole chain (choose,
                                                   apply, choose the next, apply, fill, continue) runs in one turn.
                                                   "field" fills a text field, chooses in a list or ticks a box
                                                   (value true/false); "press" clicks a button or link. It stops at
                                                   the first step whose control it cannot find unambiguously and
                                                   tells you which steps ran. Use it for forms whose fields you know.
  {"do": "done", "summary": "<ten words>", "answer": "..."}   you are finished; "answer" only when you were asked for one

Reading the page:
- It is rendered as a screen reader would read it. "(described: ...)" and "(tooltip: ...)" hold text that only
  shows on hover, "[canvas: ...]" what a drawing says, "(in collapsed menu)" an entry of a menu that is closed
  (you can click it all the same), "->" where a link leads, "{data-...}" attributes of a control.
- A "LOCKED AREA" is disabled until you pass the check in front of it. A page can hold several checks, one per
  area, also inside embedded frames further down: after passing one, look for the next LOCKED AREA and its own
  controls. A check whose status already reads as unlocked is done; setting it again changes nothing.
- A "toggle" opens or closes a section. If a section you opened stays empty after you unlocked it, click its toggle
  twice (close, then open) to load it again.
- Several controls can carry the same name while only one of them does the job: tell them apart by where they
  lead and what their attributes say.
- Popups, cookie walls, access checks, error pages and expired sessions happen. Deal with them and carry on;
  after a session expires, log in again. Surveys, tools and help pages lead away from your task.
"""

STEP_TIMEOUT = 45  # seconds for one page read or one browser action: a hung page must not freeze the whole run
# How many past turns stay word for word; older ones keep the reasoning and drop the page text. Each full turn resends
# a page of up to 14,000 characters on every call, and input tokens are most of the run's cost (the provider's prompt
# cache hits only now and then). FULL_TURNS=2 brings back the earlier setting for comparison.
FULL_TURNS = int(os.environ.get("FULL_TURNS", "1"))
NAVIGATING = {"click", "goto", "back", "reload", "login", "collect", "fetch", "steps"}
STEPS_LIMIT, STEPS_TIMEOUT = 30, 240  # one "steps" action: at most this many steps, and seconds in all
ALERT = re.compile(r"\((?:alert|status)\)[^\n]*")  # a message the page announces to screen readers (Tab.observe)
CONTROL = re.compile(r'\[(\d+)\] (?:\(in collapsed menu\) )?(select|input(?:\(\w+\))?|button|checkbox|radio|link|clickable|switch) "([^"]*)"([^\[]*)')


def find_control(page: str, label: str, kinds: tuple[str, ...]) -> tuple[str | None, str]:
    """The id of the one control of one of `kinds` labelled `label` on the rendered page: an exact label first,
    then a label that contains it. (None, why) when there is none or more than one that is not disabled."""
    wanted = " ".join(label.casefold().split())
    found = [(m.group(1), m.group(2), " ".join(m.group(3).casefold().split()), m.group(4)) for m in CONTROL.finditer(page)]
    found = [f for f in found if f[1].split("(")[0] in kinds and "disabled" not in f[3]]
    for match in ([f for f in found if f[2] == wanted], [f for f in found if wanted and wanted in f[2]]):
        ids = list(dict.fromkeys(f[0] for f in match))
        if len(ids) == 1:
            return ids[0], match[0][1]
        if len(ids) > 1:
            return None, f'{len(ids)} controls are labelled "{label}" ({", ".join("[" + i + "]" for i in ids)}): use their ids'
    return None, f'no control labelled "{label}" on the page now'


def state_fingerprint(observation: str) -> str:
    """A stable signature of the model-visible page state.

    ``Tab.observe`` assigns fresh action ids on every read.  They are useful to
    the model, but must not make an unchanged page look like a successful
    action.  Removing only those generated ids keeps visible values, errors,
    dialogs and the URL in the comparison.
    """
    stable = re.sub(r"\[\d+\]", "[]", observation)
    return hashlib.sha1(stable.encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()


def action_fingerprint(actions: list[dict], observation: str = "") -> str:
    """Use a control's visible label instead of its transient id in repeat checks."""
    stable_actions = []
    for action in actions:
        stable = {key: value for key, value in action.items() if key != "id"}
        if action.get("id") is not None:
            match = re.search(rf"(?m)^\[{re.escape(str(action['id']))}\](.*)$", observation)
            if match:
                stable["target"] = match.group(1).strip()
        stable_actions.append(stable)
    return json.dumps(stable_actions, sort_keys=True)

ESCALATION_LIMIT = 2  # stronger turns per agent: they cost reasoning time and an image


class Agent:
    def __init__(self, name: str, tab: Tab, system: str, briefing: Callable[[], str],
                 extra: dict[str, Callable[[dict], Awaitable[str]]] | None = None, deadline: float | None = None,
                 max_steps: int = 80, think: bool = False,
                 idle: Callable[[str], Awaitable[str | None]] | None = None,
                 guard: Callable[[dict], str | None] | None = None, finish_on_repeat: int | None = None, circle_hint: str | None = None):
        """`briefing()` heads every turn. `extra` adds actions: name -> handler(action) -> result text.
        `idle("done")` lets the caller hold a finished agent until there is news for it (returns the news) or
        let it stop (returns None)."""
        self.name, self.tab, self.system, self.briefing = name, tab, system, briefing
        self.extra = extra or {}
        self.deadline = deadline or time.time() + 3600
        self.max_steps, self.think, self.idle = max_steps, think, idle
        self.guard = guard
        # An agent that states the same thought this many turns in a row has its answer and is only "verifying":
        # it gets one forced final turn instead of running out of time (stress test: the courier read the right code,
        # then re-verified it for 14 turns and ended with no answer).
        self.finish_on_repeat = finish_on_repeat
        self._thoughts: list[str] = []
        self._circle_hinted = False
        self._circle_hinted_at = -99
        self._circle_hints = 0
        self._escalate = False
        self.escalations = 0  # stronger turns given (escalation plugin), at most ESCALATION_LIMIT
        self._stuck = False
        self.circle_hint = circle_hint or (
            "You are going in circles: the same steps keep repeating without progress. The page may already show "
            "what you need, including inside embedded documents: read it fully. Otherwise open the link's address "
            "directly with goto, or try a different way. If you already have the answer, finish with done now.")
        self._circle_hint: str | None = None  # a sanity check that may veto a browser action before it runs (sanity.py)
        self.turns: list[dict] = []
        self.held: tuple[str, str] | None = None  # a collected or fetched document, until the agent moves on
        self.coverage = Ledger()  # what this agent really opened, typed and followed (coverage.py)
        self.steps = 0
        self.started = time.time()

    def document(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
        """What the agent is looking at: the document it collected or fetched, else the page as last read."""
        return self.held or (self.tab.document, self.tab.document_source)

    def log(self, text: str) -> None:
        print(f"[{self.name} {self.steps:02d} t+{time.time() - self.started:.0f}s] {text}", flush=True)

    def _messages(self, user: str) -> list[dict]:
        messages = [{"role": "system", "content": self.system}]
        for index, turn in enumerate(self.turns):
            recent = index >= len(self.turns) - FULL_TURNS
            messages.append({"role": "user", "content": turn["user"] if recent else turn["short"]})
            messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": turn["assistant"]})
        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": user})
        return messages

    async def _escalated_turn(self, user: str) -> dict:
        """One stronger turn for an agent that keeps going in circles: reasoning on, and a screenshot of the page,
        which shows what the text view can hide (a slider, a disabled button, a banner over the page, a scanned
        document). The model still decides what to do; nothing about the website is assumed here."""
        text = (user + "\n\nYOU ARE STUCK: your last steps keep repeating without progress. Look at the screenshot of "
                "the page as it really is, think about why your steps did not work, and choose a different way. If "
                "what you need is not reachable from here, finish with done.")
        messages = self._messages(text)
        image = await self.tab.screenshot() if hasattr(self.tab, "screenshot") else None
        if image:
            messages[-1]["content"] = [{"type": "text", "text": text},
                                       {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": f"data:image/jpeg;base64,{image}"}}]
        self.log(f"escalated: reasoning on{', with a screenshot' if image else ', no screenshot available'}")
        reply = await llm.chat_json(messages, think=True, label=f"{self.name}:escalated")
        return reply or await llm.chat_json(self._messages(user), think=self.think, label=self.name)

    async def _steps(self, steps: list) -> str:
        """Runs a chain of label-addressed steps across page reloads (the "steps" action). Every step is turned into
        the plain action it stands for and passes the same guard as a fill, select, set or click the model sends."""
        done: list[str] = []
        for number, step in enumerate(steps[:STEPS_LIMIT], start=1):
            if not isinstance(step, dict):
                continue
            label = str(step.get("press") or step.get("field") or "")
            page = await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.observe(), STEP_TIMEOUT)
            if "press" in step:
                aid, kind = find_control(page, label, ("button", "link", "clickable"))
                action = {"do": "click", "id": aid}
            else:
                aid, kind = find_control(page, label, ("select", "input", "checkbox", "radio", "switch"))
                value = step.get("value", "")
                if kind == "select":
                    action = {"do": "select", "id": aid, "value": str(value)}
                elif kind in ("checkbox", "radio", "switch"):
                    action = {"do": "set", "id": aid, "value": value if isinstance(value, bool) else str(value).lower() not in ("false", "0", "no", "")}
                else:
                    action = {"do": "fill", "id": aid, "text": str(value)}
            if aid is None:
                return (f"ran {len(done)} of {len(steps)} steps" + (": " + "; ".join(done) if done else "") +
                        f". Stopped at step {number}: {kind}. The page is as it is now; continue from there.")
            veto = self.guard(action) if self.guard else None
            if veto:
                return f"ran {len(done)} of {len(steps)} steps" + (": " + "; ".join(done) if done else "") + f". Step {number} was refused: {veto}"
            alerts_before = set(ALERT.findall(page))
            result = await asyncio.wait_for(self._browser(action), STEP_TIMEOUT)
            done.append(f'{number}. {label}: {str(result)[:80]}')
            if action["do"] == "click":  # a press can bring an error message: stop there instead of filling on blindly
                after = await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.observe(), STEP_TIMEOUT)
                new = [a for a in ALERT.findall(after) if a not in alerts_before]
                if new:
                    return (f"ran {len(done)} of {len(steps)} steps: " + "; ".join(done) +
                            f". After step {number} the page says: {' / '.join(new)[:300]}. Fix that before going on.")
            if any(word in str(result) for word in ("has no option", "did not change", "is disabled", "BUT the field")):
                return f"ran {len(done)} of {len(steps)} steps: " + "; ".join(done) + f". Step {number} did not take; check it."
        return f"ran all {len(done)} steps: " + "; ".join(done)

    async def _browser(self, action: dict) -> str:
        do, tab = action.get("do"), self.tab
        if do == "login":
            return await tab.login()
        if do == "click":
            return await tab.click(action.get("id"))
        if do == "steps":
            return await self._steps(action.get("steps") or [])
        if do == "fill":
            return await tab.fill(action.get("id"), action.get("text", ""), bool(action.get("enter")))
        if do == "select":
            return await tab.select(action.get("id"), action.get("value", ""))
        if do == "set":
            return await tab.set(action.get("id"), action.get("value", True))
        if do == "goto":
            return await tab.goto(action.get("url", ""))
        if do == "back":
            return await tab.back()
        if do == "reload":
            return await tab.reload()
        if do == "collect":
            return await tab.collect(action.get("id"), action.get("max_pages") or 10)
        if do == "fetch":
            return await tab.fetch(action.get("id"))
        return f'unknown action "{do}"'

    def _may_close(self, action: dict) -> str | None:
        """An action that closes a question ({"question": ..., "status": "complete" | "absent"}) is checked against
        what the agent really did on its website, not against what it says it did. None lets the action run."""
        status = str(action.get("status", "")).strip().lower()
        if "question" not in action or status not in ("complete", "absent") or not sanity.enabled("coverage_gate"):
            return None
        return self.coverage.gate(str(action.get("question", "")).strip("[] "), status)

    async def _alive(self) -> bool:
        try:
            return bool(await self.tab.page.main_frame.evaluate("() => document.querySelectorAll('[data-aid]').length > 0"))
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            return False

    async def run(self) -> dict:
        results: list[str] = []
        outcome = {"done": False, "summary": "", "answer": None, "steps": 0}
        self.log(f"starting at {self.tab.base_url}")
        if self.tab.page.url in ("", "about:blank"):
            try:
                results.append(await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.goto(self.tab.base_url + "/"), STEP_TIMEOUT))
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                results.append(f"opening {self.tab.base_url} took longer than {STEP_TIMEOUT} s; reload or try again")
        repeats, last_signature, failures = 0, "", 0
        seen_signatures: dict[str, int] = {}
        stuck = 0  # page reads and navigations in a row that timed out or failed: the tab may be broken
        while self.steps < self.max_steps and time.time() < self.deadline:
            self.steps += 1
            clock = time.time()
            try:
                page = await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.observe(), STEP_TIMEOUT)
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                stuck += 1
                page = f"(the page did not finish loading within {STEP_TIMEOUT} s; reload it or go elsewhere)"
            except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
                page = f"(the page could not be read: {str(error)[:200]})"
            self.coverage.saw(page)
            results.extend(self.tab.take_events())
            done_text = "\n".join(f"{n}. {text}" for n, text in enumerate(results, 1)) or "(none yet)"
            left = int(self.deadline - time.time())
            user = (f"{self.briefing()}\n\nTIME LEFT: {left} s\n\nRESULTS OF YOUR LAST ACTIONS\n{done_text}\n\n"
                    f"CURRENT PAGE\n{page}")
            read_s = time.time() - clock
            clock = time.time()
            if self._escalate:
                self._escalate = False
                self.escalations += 1
                reply = await self._escalated_turn(user)
            else:
                reply = await llm.chat_json(self._messages(user), think=self.think, label=self.name)
            model_s = time.time() - clock
            clock = time.time()
            actions = reply.get("actions")
            if isinstance(actions, dict):
                actions = [actions]
            if not isinstance(actions, list) or not actions:
                if llm._warm.get("expired"):
                    self.log("run token expired (submission completed); stopping")
                    break
                failures += 1
                if failures >= 4:
                    self.log("the model gave no usable actions four times; stopping")
                    break
                results = ['your reply had no "actions" list; reply with {"thought": ..., "actions": [...]}']
                continue
            failures = 0
            thought = str(reply.get("thought", ""))[:300]
            self._thoughts.append(" ".join(thought.lower().split())[:160])
            recent = self._thoughts
            # Going in circles: the same thought three times (A A A), two thoughts alternating (A B A B), as in the
            # courier stress test where "unlock the list" and "open the newest message" alternated for 19 turns, or
            # the same thought three times within the last 16 turns, as in sandbox run e3804980 where the ERP agent
            # rejected the same material every 6 turns for 46 turns.
            strict = ((len(recent) >= 3 and len(set(recent[-3:])) == 1)
                      or (len(recent) >= 4 and recent[-1] == recent[-3] and recent[-2] == recent[-4] and recent[-1] != recent[-2]))
            circling = strict or recent[-16:].count(recent[-1]) >= 3
            if circling and (not self.finish_on_repeat or not self._circle_hinted):
                circling = False  # a concrete way out first; only an agent with finish_on_repeat is then forced to finish
                if len(recent) - self._circle_hinted_at >= 6:  # once every 6 turns at most
                    if self._circle_hints >= 2 and self.idle:
                        self._stuck = True  # two hints ignored: an investigator is sent idle (see below)
                    self._circle_hinted, self._circle_hinted_at = True, len(recent)
                    self._circle_hints += 1
                    self._circle_hint = self.circle_hint
                    # The second time: also one stronger turn, reasoning on and with a screenshot (sanity plugin
                    # "escalation"), before the agent is given up on at the third. Investigators only (they have an
                    # idle hook); the bid clerk, which repeats one pattern for every position on purpose (run bb0655a2), only on a
                    # strict loop: the same thought three times or two alternating (run d3ca14df: 95 turns of "fill,
                    # add position, empty again" until its step cap, never signed).
                    if self._circle_hints == 2 and (self.idle or strict) and self.escalations < ESCALATION_LIMIT \
                            and sanity.enabled("escalation"):
                        self._escalate = True
            if circling:
                final = await llm.chat_json(self._messages(
                    user + "\n\nYou have reached the same conclusion several times in a row. Stop checking and finish "
                    'NOW with exactly one action: {"do": "done", "summary": "...", "answer": "..."}, the answer being '
                    "the value you found (or no answer if you truly found none)."), think=False, label=self.name)
                done = next((a for a in (final.get("actions") or []) if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("do") == "done"), None)
                done = done or (final if final.get("do") == "done" else None)
                if done is not None:
                    self.log(f"forced to finish after going in circles: {json.dumps(done, ensure_ascii=False)[:200]}")
                    outcome.update(done=True, summary=str(done.get("summary", "")), answer=done.get("answer"))
                    break
            head = page.split("\n", 2)
            short = f"RESULTS OF YOUR LAST ACTIONS\n{done_text[:700]}\n\nPAGE (text dropped)\n" + "\n".join(head[:2])
            self.turns.append({"user": user, "short": short, "assistant": json.dumps(reply, ensure_ascii=False)})
            if os.environ.get("AGENT_TRACE"):  # what the agent saw and answered, one file per turn
                os.makedirs(os.environ["AGENT_TRACE"], exist_ok=True)
                with open(os.path.join(os.environ["AGENT_TRACE"], f"{self.name}_{self.steps:03d}.txt"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
                    handle.write(user + "\n\n===== REPLY =====\n" + json.dumps(reply, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))

            # A repeated action is a loop only if the model also sees the same
            # page.  A form may keep its URL while legitimately changing state.
            signature = action_fingerprint(actions, page) + state_fingerprint(page)
            seen_signatures[signature] = seen_signatures.get(signature, 0) + 1
            repeats = repeats + 1 if signature == last_signature else max(0, seen_signatures[signature] - 1)
            last_signature = signature

            results, finished, moved = [], None, False
            if self._circle_hint:  # shown with the results of this turn's actions, at the top of the next turn
                results.append(self._circle_hint)
                self._circle_hint = None
            for action in actions[:8]:
                if not isinstance(action, dict):
                    continue
                do = action.get("do")
                if do == "done":
                    finished = action
                    break
                if do == "wait":
                    await asyncio.sleep(2)
                    results.append("waited two seconds")
                    continue
                if do in self.extra:
                    refusal = self._may_close(action)
                    if refusal:
                        results.append(refusal)
                        continue
                    try:
                        results.append(await self.extra[do](action))
                    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
                        results.append(f"{do} failed: {str(error)[:200]}")
                    continue
                if moved:
                    results.append(f'skipped {json.dumps(action, ensure_ascii=False)[:120]}: the page changed, its ids are stale')
                    continue
                veto = self.guard(action) if self.guard else None
                if veto:
                    results.append(veto)
                    continue
                before = self.tab.page.url
                try:
                    result = await asyncio.wait_for(self._browser(action), STEPS_TIMEOUT if do == "steps" else STEP_TIMEOUT)
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    result = f"{do} took longer than {STEP_TIMEOUT} s and was stopped; the page may be stuck"
                except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
                    result = f"{do} failed: {str(error)[:200]}"
                results.append(result)
                if do == "fill" and NOT_KEPT not in str(result):  # a text the field refused was never searched
                    self.coverage.typed(before, action.get("text", ""))
                elif do == "collect":
                    self.coverage.followed(getattr(self.tab, "last_collect", None))
                # Do not trust a successful browser call by itself: enterprise
                # portals often swallow a click or reject a field silently.
                # The next model turn gets a compact, actionable state-delta
                # report rather than assuming the dispatch took effect.
                if do not in ("collect", "fetch"):
                    try:
                        after = await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.observe(), STEP_TIMEOUT)
                        changed = state_fingerprint(page) != state_fingerprint(after)
                        if changed:
                            self.coverage.moved()
                            results.append(f"verification: {do} visibly changed the page state")
                        else:
                            results.append(f"verification: {do} caused no visible page change; inspect the control "
                                           "or try a different recovery path instead of repeating it blindly")
                    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                        results.append(f"verification: could not re-read the page within {STEP_TIMEOUT} s")
                    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
                        results.append(f"verification: could not re-read the page ({str(error)[:160]})")
                if do in NAVIGATING:
                    failed = any(sign in str(result) for sign in ("Timeout", "timed out", "took longer", "detached", "ERR_ABORTED"))
                    stuck = stuck + 1 if failed else 0
                if do in ("collect", "fetch"):
                    self.held = (self.tab.document, self.tab.document_source)
                elif do in NAVIGATING:
                    self.held = None
                if do in NAVIGATING or self.tab.page.url != before or not await self._alive():
                    moved = True
            if stuck >= 2:  # the same tab failed twice in a row: carry on in a fresh one (browser_env.Tab.renew)
                stuck = 0
                try:
                    renewed = await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.renew(), STEP_TIMEOUT)
                    results.append("this tab kept failing to load, so it was replaced by a fresh one: " + renewed)
                except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
                    results.append(f"replacing the stuck tab failed: {str(error)[:150]}")
                self.held = None
            self.log(f"(read {read_s:.1f}s, model {model_s:.1f}s, act {time.time() - clock:.1f}s) {thought} | "
                     f"{json.dumps(actions, ensure_ascii=False)[:400]} | " + " ; ".join(r[:160] for r in results))
            if repeats >= 2:
                results.append("You have sent the same actions three times with the same result: they do not work "
                               "here. Read the page again from the top for another way (a further check, a toggle, a "
                               "different link, a search), or finish with done.")
            # An agent that can be held idle (an investigator) and is stuck is sent idle as if it had finished: the
            # same actions six times on an unchanged page, or still circling after two hints. Sandbox run 74b22ceb:
            # the tender-portal agent opened the same unchanged page 122 times (~8 min), and the investigation
            # waited for it until its time limit. Idle, it is woken again when the case file has news for it.
            if finished is None and self.idle and (repeats >= 5 or self._stuck):
                self.log("stuck: repeating itself without progress; sent idle until the case file has news")
                finished = {"do": "done", "summary": "stopped: repeated the same steps without progress"}
                self._stuck, self._circle_hints, self._thoughts = False, 0, []
                seen_signatures.clear()
                last_signature, repeats = "", 0
                results.append("You were sent idle because you kept repeating the same steps without progress. "
                               "Work on what the case file news asks for, by a different way than before.")
            if finished is not None:
                outcome.update(summary=str(finished.get("summary", "")), answer=finished.get("answer"))
                news = await self.idle("done") if self.idle else None
                if news is None:
                    outcome["done"] = True
                    break
                results.append(news)
        outcome["steps"] = self.steps
        return outcome

388	    """One browser tab on one website, driven by one agent."""
389	
390	    def __init__(self, page, site: dict):
391	        self.page = page
392	        self.site_id = site.get("siteId", "")
393	        self.base_url = site["url"].rstrip("/")
394	        self.credentials = site.get("credentials") or {}
395	        self.frames: list[tuple[int, int, object]] = []  # id range -> frame
396	        self.document = ""  # what `keep` files: the page as last read, a collected listing or a fetched file
397	        self.document_source = ""
398	        self.last_collect: dict | None = None  # how the last `collect` ended: where, control, pages, capped
399	        self.events: list[str] = []
400	        self.bad_status = 0
401	        self.loading: set = set()  # page, frame and data requests that have not come back yet
402	        self.spares: list = []  # browser contexts of the run's other browsers, for a renewal elsewhere (see renew)
403	        self.renewals = 0
404	        self._watch(page)
405	
406	    def _watch(self, page) -> None:
407	        page.on("dialog", lambda dialog: asyncio.ensure_future(self._on_dialog(dialog)))
408	        page.on("response", self._on_response)
409	        page.on("request", lambda request: self.loading.add(request) if request.resource_type in ("document", "xhr", "fetch") else None)
410	        page.on("requestfinished", lambda request: self.loading.discard(request))
411	        page.on("requestfailed", lambda request: self.loading.discard(request))

413	    async def renew(self) -> str:
414	        """Swap a broken tab for a fresh one in the same browser: same session and cookies, a clean page. A tab can get
415	        stuck ("frame was detached", loads that never finish) while the website itself is fine: in sandbox runs the
416	        investigators' tab kept timing out for minutes while a fresh tab on the same site loaded at once.
417	        From the second renewal on, the fresh tab opens in another of the run's browsers and logs in again: in sandbox
418	        runs 41a5de64, c3c4b1e8 and 64397a5e one browser could not load the tender portal for the whole run, fresh
419	        tabs in it included, while the other browsers kept working."""
420	        old = self.page
421	        self.renewals += 1
422	        moved = self.renewals >= 2 and bool(self.spares)
423	        context = self.spares[(self.renewals - 2) % len(self.spares)] if moved else old.context
424	        page = await context.new_page()
425	        self.page, self.frames, self.loading, self.bad_status = page, [], set(), 0
426	        self._watch(page)
427	        try:
428	            await old.close()
429	        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
430	            pass
431	        result = await self.goto(self.base_url + "/")
432	        if not moved:
433	            return result
434	        try:
435	            result += "; " + await self.login()
436	        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
437	            result += f"; logging in again failed: {str(error)[:120]}"
438	        return "moved to another browser (this one could not load the website): " + result

440	    async def screenshot(self) -> str | None:
441	        """The visible part of the page as a base64 JPEG, for a model that reads images; None when it fails."""
442	        try:
443	            import base64
444	            image = await asyncio.wait_for(self.page.screenshot(type="jpeg", quality=55, full_page=False), 15)
445	            return base64.b64encode(image).decode("ascii")
446	        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001

449	    async def _on_dialog(self, dialog):
450	        self.events.append(f'the browser asked "{dialog.message}" ({dialog.type}); it was accepted')

452	            await dialog.accept()

456	    def _on_response(self, response):

458	            if response.request.is_navigation_request() and response.frame == self.page.main_frame:
459	                self.bad_status = response.status if response.status >= 500 else 0

463	    async def settle(self):
464	        """Wait until the page, its frames and the data they fetch have arrived and nothing more is on its way."""
465	        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
466	        end, quiet = loop.time() + 12, None
467	        await asyncio.sleep(0.1)  # let a click start its request
468	        while loop.time() < end:
469	            if self.loading:
470	                quiet = None
471	            elif quiet is None:
472	                quiet = loop.time()
473	            elif loop.time() - quiet >= 0.2:
474	                break
475	            await asyncio.sleep(0.04)

477	            self.loading.clear()  # a request that never ends must not hold up every later step
478	        for frame in list(self.page.frames):
479	            try:
480	                await frame.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=8000 if frame == self.page.main_frame else 3000)
481	            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
482	                pass

484	            if not self.bad_status:

486	            self.events.append(f"the server answered HTTP {self.bad_status}; reloaded")
487	            await asyncio.sleep(0.4)

490	            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001

493	    async def _frame_text(self, frame, start: int, depth: int) -> tuple[str, int]:
494	        try:
495	            prepared = await frame.evaluate(PREPARE_JS)
496	            if prepared["opened"]:
497	                await self.settle()  # lazy content of the sections just opened
498	            for name in prepared["closed"]:

501	        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
502	            return f"{UNREADABLE}: {str(error)[:120]})", start
503	        self.frames.append((start, shot["next"], frame))

505	        for marker in re.findall(r"⟦FRAME:(\d+)⟧", text):
506	            inner = "(embedded document not loaded)"

532	    async def read(self) -> str:

558	    async def _modal_is_open(self) -> bool:

class Tab:
    """One browser tab on one website, driven by one agent."""

    def __init__(self, page, site: dict):
        self.page = page
        self.site_id = site.get("siteId", "")
        self.base_url = site["url"].rstrip("/")
        self.credentials = site.get("credentials") or {}
        self.frames: list[tuple[int, int, object]] = []  # id range -> frame
        self.document = ""  # what `keep` files: the page as last read, a collected listing or a fetched file
        self.document_source = ""
        self.last_collect: dict | None = None  # how the last `collect` ended: where, control, pages, capped
        self.events: list[str] = []
        self.bad_status = 0
        self.loading: set = set()  # page, frame and data requests that have not come back yet
        self.spares: list = []  # browser contexts of the run's other browsers, for a renewal elsewhere (see renew)
        self.renewals = 0
        self._watch(page)

    def _watch(self, page) -> None:
        page.on("dialog", lambda dialog: asyncio.ensure_future(self._on_dialog(dialog)))
        page.on("response", self._on_response)
        page.on("request", lambda request: self.loading.add(request) if request.resource_type in ("document", "xhr", "fetch") else None)
        page.on("requestfinished", lambda request: self.loading.discard(request))
        page.on("requestfailed", lambda request: self.loading.discard(request))

    async def renew(self) -> str:
        """Swap a broken tab for a fresh one in the same browser: same session and cookies, a clean page. A tab can get
        stuck ("frame was detached", loads that never finish) while the website itself is fine: in sandbox runs the
        investigators' tab kept timing out for minutes while a fresh tab on the same site loaded at once.
        From the second renewal on, the fresh tab opens in another of the run's browsers and logs in again: in sandbox
        runs 41a5de64, c3c4b1e8 and 64397a5e one browser could not load the tender portal for the whole run, fresh
        tabs in it included, while the other browsers kept working."""
        old = self.page
        self.renewals += 1
        moved = self.renewals >= 2 and bool(self.spares)
        context = self.spares[(self.renewals - 2) % len(self.spares)] if moved else old.context
        page = await context.new_page()
        self.page, self.frames, self.loading, self.bad_status = page, [], set(), 0
        self._watch(page)
        try:
            await old.close()
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass
        result = await self.goto(self.base_url + "/")
        if not moved:
            return result
        try:
            result += "; " + await self.login()
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            result += f"; logging in again failed: {str(error)[:120]}"
        return "moved to another browser (this one could not load the website): " + result

    async def screenshot(self) -> str | None:
        """The visible part of the page as a base64 JPEG, for a model that reads images; None when it fails."""
        try:
            import base64
            image = await asyncio.wait_for(self.page.screenshot(type="jpeg", quality=55, full_page=False), 15)
            return base64.b64encode(image).decode("ascii")
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            return None

    async def _on_dialog(self, dialog):
        self.events.append(f'the browser asked "{dialog.message}" ({dialog.type}); it was accepted')
        try:
            await dialog.accept()
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass

    def _on_response(self, response):
        try:
            if response.request.is_navigation_request() and response.frame == self.page.main_frame:
                self.bad_status = response.status if response.status >= 500 else 0
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass

    async def settle(self):
        """Wait until the page, its frames and the data they fetch have arrived and nothing more is on its way."""
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
        end, quiet = loop.time() + 12, None
        await asyncio.sleep(0.1)  # let a click start its request
        while loop.time() < end:
            if self.loading:
                quiet = None
            elif quiet is None:
                quiet = loop.time()
            elif loop.time() - quiet >= 0.2:
                break
            await asyncio.sleep(0.04)
        else:
            self.loading.clear()  # a request that never ends must not hold up every later step
        for frame in list(self.page.frames):
            try:
                await frame.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=8000 if frame == self.page.main_frame else 3000)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass
        for _ in range(3):  # a server error page: retry the same address, as a person would press reload
            if not self.bad_status:
                break
            self.events.append(f"the server answered HTTP {self.bad_status}; reloaded")
            await asyncio.sleep(0.4)
            try:
                await self.page.reload(wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=15000)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                break

    async def _frame_text(self, frame, start: int, depth: int) -> tuple[str, int]:
        try:
            prepared = await frame.evaluate(PREPARE_JS)
            if prepared["opened"]:
                await self.settle()  # lazy content of the sections just opened
            for name in prepared["closed"]:
                self.events.append(f'closed the popup "{name}"')
            shot = await frame.evaluate(SNAPSHOT_JS, start)
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            return f"{UNREADABLE}: {str(error)[:120]})", start
        self.frames.append((start, shot["next"], frame))
        text, following = shot["text"], shot["next"]
        for marker in re.findall(r"⟦FRAME:(\d+)⟧", text):
            inner = "(embedded document not loaded)"
            if depth < 4:
                try:
                    handle = await frame.query_selector(f'[data-aid="{marker}"]')
                    child = await handle.content_frame() if handle else None
                    if child:
                        try:
                            await child.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=4000)
                        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                            pass
                        inner, following = await self._frame_text(child, following, depth + 1)
                except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
                    inner = f"(embedded document could not be read: {str(error)[:120]})"
            block = "┌── embedded document: " if inner.strip() else "┌── embedded document (empty): "
            text = text.replace(f"⟦FRAME:{marker}⟧", block, 1).replace(
                block, block, 1)
            # the marker line carries the frame's title; append the frame's content under it
            lines = text.split("\n")
            for index, line in enumerate(lines):
                if line.startswith(block) and not line.endswith("⁣"):
                    lines[index] = line + "⁣"
                    lines.insert(index + 1, "\n".join("│ " + row for row in inner.split("\n")) + "\n└── end of embedded document")
                    break
            text = "\n".join(lines)
        return text.replace("⁣", ""), following

    async def read(self) -> str:
        """The current page as text, with fresh element ids."""
        for _ in range(4):  # a page that navigates while it is read is read again
            await self.settle()
            self.frames = []
            text, _ = await self._frame_text(self.page.main_frame, 1, 0)
            if not text.startswith(UNREADABLE):
                break
        try:
            title = await self.page.title()
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            title = ""
        self.document = f"url: {self.page.url}\ntitle: {clean_text(title)}\n{clean_text(text)}"
        self.document_source = self.page.url
        return self.document

    async def observe(self) -> str:
        text = await self.read()
        if len(text) > MAX_OBSERVATION:
            text = text[:MAX_OBSERVATION] + f"\n… (page text cut here; {len(text) - MAX_OBSERVATION} more characters. `keep` files the whole page.)"
        return text

    def take_events(self) -> list[str]:
        events, self.events = self.events, []
        return events

    async def _modal_is_open(self) -> bool:
        """Whether a page-level dialog now prevents ordinary controls from being used."""
        script = """() => {
          const visible = el => { const s = getComputedStyle(el); return !el.hidden && el.getAttribute('aria-hidden') !== 'true' && s.display !== 'none' && s.visibility !== 'hidden'; };
          return [...document.querySelectorAll('dialog[open],[aria-modal="true"]')]
            .some(el => visible(el) && (el.tagName !== 'DIALOG' || el.matches(':modal')));
        }"""
        for frame in self.page.frames:
            try:
                if await frame.evaluate(script):
                    return True
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                continue
        return False

    def _locator(self, aid):
        try:
            number = int(aid)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return None
        for start, end, frame in self.frames:
            if start <= number < end:
                return frame.locator(f'[data-aid="{number}"]')
        return None

    async def _describe(self, locator) -> dict:
        info = await self._describe_raw(locator)
        info["name"] = clean_text(info["name"])[:80]  # without the invisible characters pages hide in names
        return info

    async def _describe_raw(self, locator) -> dict:
        return await locator.evaluate(
            """el => ({tag: el.tagName, type: (el.getAttribute('type') || '').toLowerCase(), href: el.href || '',
                      disabled: el.disabled === true || !!el.closest('fieldset[disabled],[inert]'),
                      name: (el.innerText || el.value || el.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 400)})""")

    async def click(self, aid) -> str:
        locator = self._locator(aid)
        if locator is None or await locator.count() == 0:
            return f"there is no element [{aid}] on the page any more; read the current page"
        info = await self._describe(locator)
        if info["disabled"]:
            return f"[{aid}] is disabled (inside a locked or inert area?); nothing happened"
        before = self.page.url
        try:
            await locator.click(timeout=2500)
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001  hidden in a collapsed menu, or covered: activate it directly
            try:
                await locator.evaluate("el => el.click()")
            except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
                return f"could not click [{aid}]: {str(error)[:150]}"
        await self.settle()
        if await self._modal_is_open():
            return "the page now has a modal dialog; read it before acting behind it"
        moved = self.page.url != before
        return f'clicked [{aid}] "{info["name"]}"' + (f"; now at {self.page.url}" if moved else "")

    async def fill(self, aid, text: str, enter: bool = False) -> str:
        locator = self._locator(aid)
        if locator is None or await locator.count() == 0:
            return f"there is no element [{aid}] on the page any more"
        try:
            await locator.fill(str(text), timeout=2500)
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            return f"could not fill [{aid}]: {str(error)[:150]}"
        readback = await self._readback(locator, str(text))  # before Enter can load another page
        if enter:
            await locator.press("Enter")
            await self.settle()
        if await self._modal_is_open():
            return "the page now has a modal dialog; read it before acting behind it"
        return f"filled [{aid}]" + (" and pressed Enter" if enter else "") + readback

    async def _readback(self, locator, typed: str) -> str:
        """What a field holds right after typing, when that is not what was typed: a form can reformat, cut or
        silently refuse a value, and a fill that "worked" proves nothing about what the portal will save."""
        try:
            kind, value = await locator.evaluate(
                """el => [(el.getAttribute('type') || '').toLowerCase(),
                          'value' in el ? String(el.value) : (el.isContentEditable ? el.innerText : null)]""")
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            return ""
        if kind == "password" or value is None:
            return ""
        shown, wanted = clean_text(value), clean_text(typed)
        if shown == wanted:
            return ""
        if same_value(wanted, shown):
            return f'; the field shows it as "{shown[:80]}"'
        return (f'; {NOT_KEPT} "{shown[:80]}", not what was typed: it changed or refused the value. '
                "Read the field's hint and correct it before you move on")

    async def select(self, aid, value: str) -> str:
        locator = self._locator(aid)
        if locator is None or await locator.count() == 0:
            return f"there is no element [{aid}] on the page any more"
        wanted = str(value)
        for attempt in ({"value": wanted}, {"label": wanted}):
            try:
                await locator.select_option(timeout=2000, **attempt)
                await self.settle()
                if await self._modal_is_open():
                    return "the page now has a modal dialog; read it before acting behind it"
                return f'selected "{wanted}" in [{aid}]'
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                continue
        options = await locator.evaluate("el => [...(el.options || [])].map(o => o.value + '=' + o.textContent.trim())")
        loose = [o.split("=", 1)[0] for o in options if wanted.lower() in o.lower()]
        if len(loose) == 1:
            await locator.select_option(value=loose[0])
            await self.settle()
            return f'selected "{loose[0]}" in [{aid}]'
        return f'[{aid}] has no option "{wanted}"; options: {"; ".join(options)[:600]}'

    async def set(self, aid, value) -> str:
        locator = self._locator(aid)
        if locator is None or await locator.count() == 0:
            return f"there is no element [{aid}] on the page any more"
        info = await self._describe(locator)
        if info["disabled"]:
            return f"[{aid}] is disabled; nothing happened"
        try:
            if info["type"] in ("checkbox", "radio"):
                wanted = bool(value)
                try:
                    await locator.set_checked(wanted, timeout=1500)
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001  covered or restyled: toggle it as its label would
                    if await locator.is_checked() != wanted:
                        await locator.evaluate("el => el.click()")
                if await locator.is_checked() != wanted:
                    return f"[{aid}] did not change; it is still {'unchecked' if wanted else 'checked'}"
            else:  # a slider or another input whose value is set in one go
                await locator.evaluate(
                    """(el, v) => { const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(el); const d = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(proto, 'value');
                                   d && d.set ? d.set.call(el, String(v)) : el.value = String(v);
                                   el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true})); }""",
                    value)
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            return f"could not set [{aid}]: {str(error)[:150]}"
        await self.settle()
        if await self._modal_is_open():
            return "the page now has a modal dialog; read it before acting behind it"
        return f"set [{aid}] to {value}"

    def _on_site(self, url: str) -> bool:
        return urlparse(url).netloc == urlparse(self.base_url).netloc

    async def goto(self, url: str) -> str:
        target = urljoin(self.page.url if self._on_site(self.page.url) else self.base_url + "/", str(url).strip())
        if not self._on_site(target):
            return f"{target} is not on this website; you only work on {self.base_url}"
        try:
            await self.page.goto(target, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=20000)
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            return f"could not open {target}: {str(error)[:150]}"
        await self.settle()
        return f"opened {self.page.url}"

    async def back(self) -> str:
        try:
            await self.page.go_back(wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=15000)
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            return f"could not go back: {str(error)[:120]}"
        await self.settle()
        return f"went back to {self.page.url}"

    async def reload(self) -> str:
        try:
            await self.page.reload(wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=15000)
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            return f"could not reload: {str(error)[:120]}"
        await self.settle()
        return "reloaded the page"

    async def login(self) -> str:
        if not self.credentials.get("password"):
            return "there are no credentials for this website"
        outcome = "no password field on this page"
        for frame in self.page.frames:
            try:
                outcome = await frame.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, [self.credentials.get("username", ""), self.credentials["password"]])
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                continue
            if outcome == "ok":
                await frame.locator("[data-login-password]").first.press("Enter")
                await self.settle()
                return f"entered the credentials and submitted the login form; now at {self.page.url}"
        return outcome

    async def collect(self, aid, max_pages: int = 10) -> str:
        """Follow the paging control the model chose until it is gone, and return every page as one document.
        `last_collect` records how it ended: a list that stopped at the page limit with its control still there is
        not complete, and the answer says so instead of passing for the whole list."""
        self.last_collect = None
        locator = self._locator(aid)
        if locator is None or await locator.count() == 0:
            return f"there is no element [{aid}] on the page any more"
        info = await self._describe(locator)
        if not info["name"]:
            return f"[{aid}] has no label to follow from page to page"
        first, start = self.document, self.page.url
        pages, seen = [first], {first}
        limit = max(1, min(int(max_pages or 10), 30))

        async def next_control():
            for _, _, frame in self.frames:
                candidates = frame.locator("a[href], button, [role=button], [role=link]")
                for index in range(min(await candidates.count(), 200)):
                    candidate = candidates.nth(index)
                    try:
                        label = clean_text(await candidate.evaluate("el => el.innerText || el.value || el.getAttribute('aria-label') || ''"))[:80]
                        if label == info["name"] and (await candidate.evaluate("el => el.tagName")) == info["tag"] \
                                and not await candidate.evaluate(
                                    "el => el.disabled === true || el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true'"):
                            return candidate
                    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                        continue
            return None

        capped = False
        for turn in range(limit):
            control = await next_control()
            if control is None:
                break
            if turn == limit - 1:  # the page limit ended this, not the list: the control is still there
                capped = True
                break
            try:
                await control.click(timeout=2500)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                try:
                    await control.evaluate("el => el.click()")
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    break
            await self.read()
            if self.document in seen:
                break
            seen.add(self.document)
            pages.append(self.document)
        self.last_collect = {"where": start, "control": info["name"], "pages": len(pages), "capped": capped}
        more = (f' THE LIST IS NOT COMPLETE: this stopped at the limit of {limit} page(s) and "{info["name"]}" is '
                "still there. Collect again from this page (a higher max_pages reads further) before you treat the "
                "list as complete." if capped else "")
        if len(pages) == 1:
            return (f"max_pages {limit} reads only the page you see." + more if capped
                    else f'"{info["name"]}" led to no further page; the list is the page you see')
        # A button may append rows in place rather than lead to a new page. Compare page bodies without generated
        # element ids or the changing paging control: both change between reads even when every earlier row remains.
        def body(page: str) -> str:
            return "\n".join(line for line in without_ids(page).splitlines()
                             if not re.match(r'(?:button|link) "', line.strip()))

        bodies = [body(page) for page in pages]
        grows = (len(pages) > 1 and info["tag"].upper() != "A"
                 and all(later.startswith(earlier) and len(later) >= len(earlier)
                         for earlier, later in zip(bodies, bodies[1:])))
        if grows:  # a "load more" control: the last page holds every row
            self.document = pages[-1]
            return (f'followed "{info["name"]}" {len(pages) - 1} time(s); '
                    + ("the rows loaded so far are on the page." + more if capped
                       else "the list is now complete on the page"))
        self.document = "\n".join(f"{PAGE_BREAK} {number} =====\n{page}" for number, page in enumerate(pages, 1))
        return (f'followed "{info["name"]}" through {len(pages)} page(s); you are on the last one.{more} COLLECTED '
                f"DOCUMENT (file it with keep if it is relevant):\n{without_ids(self.document)[:MAX_OBSERVATION * 2]}")

    async def fetch(self, aid) -> str:
        """Download what the chosen link points to and read it as a document."""
        locator = self._locator(aid)
        if locator is None or await locator.count() == 0:
            return f"there is no element [{aid}] on the page any more"
        target = await locator.evaluate("el => el.href || el.src || el.getAttribute('data-url') || el.getAttribute('formaction') || ''")
        if not target:
            return f"[{aid}] has no address to download"
        target = urljoin(self.page.url, target)
        if not self._on_site(target):
            return f"{target} is not on this website"
        try:
            response = await self.page.context.request.get(target, timeout=20000)
            data = await response.body()

OPENAI_MODEL = os.environ.get("OPENAI_MODEL", "")


def _session(provider: str = "qwen") -> tuple[AsyncOpenAI, asyncio.Semaphore]:
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    if _bound.get("loop") is not loop:
        _bound.clear()
        _bound["loop"] = loop
    if provider not in _bound:
        if provider == "openai":
            client = AsyncOpenAI(base_url=os.environ.get("OPENAI_BASE_URL") or "https://api.openai.com/v1",
                                 api_key=os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"], timeout=CALL_TIMEOUT, max_retries=0)
        else:
            client = AsyncOpenAI(base_url=os.environ["QWEN_BASE_URL"], api_key=os.environ["QWEN_API_KEY"],
                                 timeout=CALL_TIMEOUT, max_retries=0)  # the retries are ours, so that they are counted
        _bound[provider] = (client, asyncio.Semaphore(MAX_CONCURRENT))
    return _bound[provider]


def parse_json_object(text: str | None) -> dict | None:
    """The JSON object in a model's reply, or None: a thinking block, code fences and text around it are ignored."""
    text = re.sub(r"<think>.*?</think>", "", text or "", flags=re.DOTALL).strip()
    if not text:
        return None
    candidates = [text]
    fenced = re.search(r"```(?:json)?\s*(.*?)```", text, re.DOTALL)
    if fenced:
        candidates.append(fenced.group(1).strip())
    start, end = text.find("{"), text.rfind("}")
    if 0 <= start < end:
        candidates.append(text[start:end + 1])
    for candidate in candidates:
        try:
            parsed = json.loads(candidate, strict=False)  # models put raw line breaks into strings
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if isinstance(parsed, dict):
            return parsed
    if start >= 0:  # an object followed by text that has braces of its own
        try:
            parsed, _ = json.JSONDecoder(strict=False).raw_decode(text[start:])
        except ValueError:
            return None
        if isinstance(parsed, dict):
            return parsed
    return None


def _count(usage, provider: str = "qwen") -> None:
    if usage is None:
        return
    if provider != "qwen":  # priced differently: kept apart from the Qwen estimate
        STATS[f"{provider}_tokens"] = STATS.get(f"{provider}_tokens", 0) + (usage.prompt_tokens or 0) + (usage.completion_tokens or 0)
        return
    STATS["prompt_tokens"] += usage.prompt_tokens or 0
    STATS["completion_tokens"] += usage.completion_tokens or 0
    STATS["cached_tokens"] += getattr(usage.prompt_tokens_details, "cached_tokens", None) or 0


async def chat_json(messages: list[dict], *, think: bool = True, max_tokens: int = 6000, label: str = "",
                    provider: str = "qwen") -> dict:
    """One chat call that answers with a JSON object. {} when every attempt failed; it never raises.

    `think` turns the model's reasoning on or off: off is about twice as fast, for the easy steps. `label` names the
    caller in the failure lines on stderr.
    """
    try:
        client, gate = _session(provider)
    except KeyError as missing:
        STATS["failed"] += 1
        print(f"[llm] {label or 'call'}: {missing} is not set, no model to ask", file=sys.stderr)
        return {}
    conversation = messages
    for attempt in range(1, ATTEMPTS + 1):
        permanent = False
        try:
            async with gate:
                STATS["calls"] += 1
                started = time.monotonic()
                try:
                    if provider == "openai":
                        request = client.chat.completions.create(
                            model=OPENAI_MODEL, messages=conversation, max_completion_tokens=max_tokens,
                            response_format={"type": "json_object"})
                    else:
                        request = client.chat.completions.create(
                            model=MODEL, messages=conversation, temperature=0, max_tokens=max_tokens,
                            response_format={"type": "json_object"},
                            extra_body={"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": think}})
                    reply = await asyncio.wait_for(request,
                        WARM_TIMEOUT if _warm["done"] and not think else CALL_TIMEOUT)
                    _warm["done"] = True
                finally:
                    spent = time.monotonic() - started
                    STATS["seconds"] += spent
                    kind = BY_LABEL.setdefault(label.split(":")[0] if label.startswith("extract") else (label or "call"), [0, 0.0, 0])
                    kind[0] += 1
                    kind[1] += spent
            _count(reply.usage, provider)
            kind[2] += getattr(reply.usage, "prompt_tokens", 0) or 0
            choice = reply.choices[0]
            content = choice.message.content or ""
            parsed = parse_json_object(content)
            if parsed is not None:
                return parsed
            if choice.finish_reason == "length":
                problem = f"the reply was cut off at {max_tokens} tokens"
                if max_tokens >= MAX_TOKENS_CEILING:
                    think = False
                max_tokens = min(max_tokens * 2, MAX_TOKENS_CEILING)
            else:
                problem = f"the reply is not a JSON object: {content[:120]!r}"
                conversation = [*messages, {"role": "assistant", "content": content[:2000]},
                                {"role": "user", "content": REMINDER}]
        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
            problem = f"no reply within {WARM_TIMEOUT if _warm['done'] and not think else CALL_TIMEOUT} s"
        except APIStatusError as error:
            problem = f"HTTP {error.status_code}: {str(error)[:200]}"
            permanent = error.status_code in PERMANENT
            if error.status_code == 401 and "finished or expired" in str(error).lower():
                _warm["expired"] = True
        except Exception as error:  # the connection, the proxy, a reply without choices
            problem = f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}"
        STATS["failed"] += 1
        last = attempt == ATTEMPTS or bool(_warm.get("expired")) or (permanent and attempt >= 2)
        print(f"[llm] {label or 'call'}: attempt {attempt} failed, {problem}" + ("; giving up" if last else ""),
              file=sys.stderr)
        if last:
            break
        await asyncio.sleep(min(2 ** attempt, 20) * random.uniform(0.5, 1))
    return {}


def summary() -> str:
    """The run's model use in one line, with what it costs at the hosted model's simulated prices."""
    fresh = STATS["prompt_tokens"] - STATS["cached_tokens"]
    cost = (fresh * PRICE_INPUT + STATS["cached_tokens"] * PRICE_CACHED
            + STATS["completion_tokens"] * PRICE_OUTPUT) / 1_000_000
    return (f"LLM: {STATS['calls']} calls ({STATS['failed']} failed), {STATS['prompt_tokens']} prompt tokens "
            f"({STATS['cached_tokens']} cached), {STATS['completion_tokens']} completion tokens, "
            f"{STATS['seconds']:.0f} s in calls, about ${cost:.4f}; by caller: "
            + ", ".join(f"{name} {calls}x/{seconds:.0f}s/{tokens // 1000}k in" for name, (calls, seconds, tokens) in sorted(BY_LABEL.items()))
