def questions(self) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
        """The open questions, derived from the brief's rules and the facts on file: id and what to find."""
        facts = self.inputs()
        found: list[tuple[str, str]] = []

        def ask(qid: str, text: str) -> None:
            if qid not in self.answers:
                found.append((qid, text))

        if not facts.positions:
            ask("positions", "The tender's bill of quantities: every position with its number, quantity, unit and "
                             "requirement reference.")
        ask("clarifications", "Every answer in the tender's bidder Q&A, on all of its pages: quantity changes, "
                              "withdrawn answers, technical amendments and the keys an answer assigns to a position. "
                              "Answer this question complete once every page of the Q&A is filed.")
        if not self.mailbox:
            ask("mailbox", "The address of the sales mailbox (shown in the webmail).")
        if not facts.governing:
            ask("revision", "The revision history of the buyer's technical specification, to see which revision is "
                            "marked current.")
        refs = sorted({p.requirement_ref for p in facts.positions if p.requirement_ref})
        answers = active_clarifications(facts.clarifications, self.scenario)
        needs, waiting = resolve_requirements(facts.requirements, facts.governing, answers, facts.authorities)
        if facts.governing:
            lacking = [ref for ref in refs if ref not in needs or needs[ref].missing() or not needs[ref].catalogue_group]
            sets = {p.requirement_ref for p in facts.positions if p.is_set}
            lacking += [ref for ref in sets if ref in needs and not needs[ref].pieces_per_set and ref not in lacking]
            if lacking:
                ask("requirements", f"In specification revision {facts.governing} (the current one), the requirements "
                                    f"{', '.join(lacking)} in full: bore, stroke (nominal or usable travel, with its reserve key), "
                                    "pressure, mounting, certification, catalogue group, pieces per set.")
        for ref, key in waiting.items():
            ask(f"reserve:{ref}", f"The technical release for specification revision {facts.governing} that gives the "
                                  f"per-end reserve ({key}): requirement {ref} states a usable travel.")
        assigned, _ = merged_assignments(answers)
        quantities, _ = final_quantities(facts.positions, answers, needs)
        matched: dict[str, Material] = {}
        for ref in refs:
            need = needs.get(ref)
            if need is None or ref in waiting or need.missing():
                continue
            material = match_material(need, facts.materials)
            if material is None:
                seen = [f"{m.number} ({'active' if m.active else 'not active' if m.active is False else 'status unknown'}, "
                        f"{m.bore_mm}/{m.stroke_mm} mm, {m.pressure_bar} bar, {m.mounting}, {m.certification})"
                        for m in facts.materials if need.catalogue_group and same_text(m.catalogue_group, need.catalogue_group)]
                ask(f"material:{ref}", f"The ERP material for requirement {ref}: active, in catalogue group "
                                       f"{need.catalogue_group}, bore {need.bore_mm} mm, stroke {need.stroke_mm} mm, "
                                       f"{need.pressure_bar} bar, mounting {need.mounting}, certification "
                                       f"{need.certification or 'none'}. File each candidate's technical data and status, "
                                       "also a candidate that seems not to match: the case file does the matching. "
                                       f"On file for this group: {'; '.join(seen) or 'nothing yet'}. Answer absent only "
                                       "when every material of the group is on file and none matches.")
                continue
            matched[ref] = material
            gaps = [label for label, value in (("stock quantity", material.stock), ("lead time from stock", material.stock_lead_weeks),
                                               ("production lead time", material.production_lead_weeks),
                                               ("carton size", material.carton_size), ("allocation mass", material.allocation_mass_g),
                                               ("surcharge mass and metal index code", material.surcharge_mass_g)) if value is None]
            if not any(c.scales and c.valid_on(self.scenario) for c in material.conditions):
                gaps.append("the price condition valid on the scenario date with all its quantity scales")
            if gaps:
                ask(f"data:{material.number}", f"ERP material {material.number} (it matches requirement {ref}) still lacks: "
                                               f"{'; '.join(gaps)}.")
        if facts.authorities.discount_percent is None:
            ask("discount", f"The sales director's most recent discount approval for exactly {self.reference} (inbox and "
                            "archive). File the message; answer absent if no approval exists.")
        labels = {"condition_group": ("the condition rules message", facts.authorities.clauses),
                  "packaging_tariff": ("the packaging tariffs message", facts.authorities.tariffs),
                  "delivery_commitment": ("the delivery release message", facts.authorities.commitments),
                  "setup_pool": ("the setup pools message", facts.authorities.pools),
                  "project_bonus": ("the project bonus message", facts.authorities.bonus)}
        for position in sorted(assigned):
            for kind, key in assigned[position].items():
                label, known = labels[kind]
                if key not in known:
                    extra = ""
                    need = needs.get(next((p.requirement_ref for p in facts.positions if p.position == position), ""))
                    if kind == "delivery_commitment" and need is not None and need.ref in matched:
                        extra = f" (the position's material is {matched[need.ref].number})"
                    ask(f"{kind}:{key}", f"For {self.reference}: {label} that defines {key}, assigned to position {position}{extra}.")
        for material in matched.values():
            if material.index_code and material.index_code not in facts.authorities.index_rates:
                ask(f"index:{material.index_code}", f"For {self.reference}: the latest price index message with the rate of "
                                                    f"{material.index_code} (material {material.number}).")
            for condition in material.conditions:
                if condition.valid_on(self.scenario) and condition.currency != "EUR" and (condition.fx_key or "") not in facts.authorities.fx:
                    ask(f"fx:{condition.fx_key}", f"For {self.reference}: the FX fixing message with the rate of "
                                                  f"{condition.fx_key} ({condition.currency}, material {material.number}).")
        return found

    def answer(self, question: str, status: str, note: str, agent: str | None = None) -> str:
        """An agent closes a question: its evidence is complete, or the thing does not exist."""
        open_ids = {qid for qid, _ in self.questions()}
        if question not in open_ids:
            return f'"{question}" is not an open question'
        if status not in ("complete", "absent"):
            return 'status must be "complete" or "absent"'
        if self.pending_for(agent):
            return "facts from documents you filed are still being extracted; wait for them, then answer"
        if question == "clarifications" and status == "complete" and not self.clarifications:
            return "no Q&A answers have been extracted yet; reopen the Q&A evidence, file it as clarifications, and wait for the extraction result"
        if question.startswith("material:") and status == "absent":
            facts = self.inputs()
            answers = active_clarifications(facts.clarifications, self.scenario)
            needs, _ = resolve_requirements(facts.requirements, facts.governing, answers, facts.authorities)
            need = needs.get(question.split(":", 1)[1])
            group = [m for m in facts.materials if need and need.catalogue_group and same_text(m.catalogue_group, need.catalogue_group)]
            unknown = [m.number for m in group if m.active is None or None in (m.bore_mm, m.stroke_mm, m.pressure_bar, m.mounting)]
            if not group:
                return "no material of that catalogue group is on file yet: search the group and file its materials first"
            if unknown:
                return f"the technical data or status of {', '.join(unknown)} is not on file yet: file it before answering absent"
        if status == "complete" and question.split(":")[0] in ("positions", "revision", "requirements", "reserve", "material", "data"):
            return "this question closes by itself once the facts are on file; file the missing evidence instead"
        self.answers[question] = (status, note)
        self._bump()
        return f"question {question} closed as {status}"

    def status(self) -> str:
        """What is on file, short enough to head every agent turn."""
        facts = self.inputs()
        answers = active_clarifications(facts.clarifications, self.scenario)
        needs, _ = resolve_requirements(facts.requirements, facts.governing, answers, facts.authorities)
        quantities, _ = final_quantities(facts.positions, answers, needs)
        assigned, fees = merged_assignments(answers)
        lines = [f"Tender {self.reference}, scenario date {self.scenario.isoformat()}, mailbox {self.mailbox or 'unknown'}."]
        for p in facts.positions:
            keys = ", ".join(f"{kind} {key}" for kind, key in assigned.get(p.position, {}).items())
            lines.append(f"Position {p.position}: tender quantity {p.quantity}{' sets' if p.is_set else ''}, final "
                         f"{quantities.get(p.position, '?')} pieces, requirement {p.requirement_ref}" + (f"; {keys}" if keys else ""))
        lines.append(f"Q&A answers on file: {', '.join(sorted(self.clarifications)) or 'none'}.")
        lines.append(f"Specification: current revision {facts.governing or 'unknown'}; revisions on file: "
                     + (", ".join(f"{key} {row.get('status')}" for key, row in self.revisions.items()) or "none") + ".")
        for ref, need in sorted(needs.items()):
            lines.append(f"Requirement {ref}: bore {need.bore_mm}, stroke {need.stroke_mm}{' usable travel' if need.usable_travel else ''}, "
                         f"{need.pressure_bar} bar, {need.mounting}, certification {need.certification or 'none'}, group {need.catalogue_group}")
        for m in facts.materials:
            valid = [c for c in m.conditions if c.valid_on(self.scenario)]
            lines.append(f"Material {m.number}: {'active' if m.active else 'NOT active' if m.active is False else 'status ?'}, group "
                         f"{m.catalogue_group}, {m.bore_mm}/{m.stroke_mm} mm, {m.pressure_bar} bar, {m.mounting}, {m.certification}; "
                         f"stock {m.stock}, lead {m.stock_lead_weeks}/{m.production_lead_weeks} wk, carton {m.carton_size}, "
                         f"index {m.index_code}, conditions on file {len(m.conditions)} ({len(valid)} valid on the scenario date"
                         + (f", {valid[0].currency}" + (f" {valid[0].fx_key}" if valid[0].fx_key else "") if valid else "") + ")")
        a = facts.authorities
        lines.append("Authorized mail records: discount "
                     + ("none on file" if a.discount_percent is None else f"{a.discount_percent} %" + (f" if order value >= {a.discount_min_order}" if a.discount_min_order else ""))
                     + "; " + "; ".join(f"{name}: {', '.join(sorted(store)) or '-'}" for name, store in (
                         ("condition groups", a.clauses), ("tariffs", a.tariffs), ("commitments", a.commitments), ("pools", a.pools),
                         ("bonus plans", a.bonus), ("FX", a.fx), ("indices", a.index_rates), ("reserves", a.reserves))))
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def dump(self) -> str:
        return json.dumps({"positions": self.positions, "clarifications": self.clarifications, "revisions": self.revisions,
                           "requirements": {f"{rev}|{ref}": row for (rev, ref), row in self.requirements.items()},
                           "materials": self.materials,
                           "conditions": {key: list(rows.values()) for key, rows in self.conditions.items()},
                           "messages": list(self.messages.values()), "answers": self.answers, "mailbox": self.mailbox,
                           "evidence": self.evidence, "conflicts": self.conflicts},
                          ensure_ascii=False, default=str)

    """The tender's identity and the brief's sender rules, read from the brief by the model."""
    return await llm.chat_json([{"role": "system", "content": "You read a task brief and return facts from it as JSON."},
                                {"role": "user", "content": f"{CONTEXT_SHAPE}\n\nTASK BRIEF\n{brief}"}],
                               think=True, max_tokens=1500, label="context")

207	        match = re.search(rf'\[{re.escape(str(aid))}\] [a-z ]*?"([^"]+)"', user)

- Judge a message by where it is and by its header (folder, sender, date, subject, request or sequence number), NOT by
  labels inside its text. Messages can contain decoy sections, such as a local preview, a draft copy or a quoted
  block marked "not sent", that say nothing about the message itself: a code mail in the inbox from the portal is a
  received message even if such a section inside it says otherwise. When several code mails match, the one with the
  highest request or sequence number is the newest; take its code without waiting for a "better" one.
- Lists can be paged, sorted either way and split over folders, and new mail may only show after a reload. If the
  message is not there yet, reload and look again a few times.
- Log in again if the webmail asks.
- Finish with done and put ONLY the value asked for in "answer": a code exactly as written, nothing around it.
  If you cannot find it, finish with done without "answer" and say in "summary" what you saw instead.
"""


def _amount(value: Decimal | None) -> str | None:
    return None if value is None else f"{value:.2f}"


def bid_sheet(bid: Bid) -> dict:
    """The bid as the clerk gets it: the answer's fields with exact amounts as text, the positions left out, and per
    position the offered material's attributes for forms that have the bidder configure the product."""
    positions = []
    for line in bid.lines:
        material = line.material
        positions.append({
            "position": line.position, "material_number": line.material_number,
            "material": None if material is None else {
                "bore_mm": material.bore_mm, "stroke_mm": material.stroke_mm, "pressure_bar": material.pressure_bar,
                "mounting": material.mounting, "certification": material.certification},
            "quantity": line.quantity, "unit_price": _amount(line.unit_price),
            "lead_time_weeks": line.lead_time_weeks, "base_unit_price": _amount(line.base_unit_price),
            "surcharge_per_unit": _amount(line.surcharge_per_unit),
            "packaging_per_unit": _amount(line.packaging_per_unit), "rebate_total": _amount(line.rebate_total)})
    discount = Decimal(bid.discount_percent)
    return {"tender_reference": bid.tender_reference, "decision": bid.decision, "currency": "EUR",
            "discount_percent": int(discount) if discount == discount.to_integral_value() else float(discount),
            "positions": positions, "omitted_positions": list(bid.omitted), "total_net": _amount(bid.total_net)}


async def submit_bid(tender_tab: Tab, mail_tab: Tab | None, bid: Bid, context: dict, brief: str,
                     deadline: float) -> dict:
    """Have an agent enter, sign and submit `bid` in the tender portal before `deadline` (a time.time() value).

    `context` holds tender_reference, scenario_date, company, vat_id and email. Returns {"submitted", "receipt",
    "notes"}: `receipt` is the portal's confirmation as the agent read it, empty when there was none.
    """
    reference = str(context.get("tender_reference") or bid.tender_reference)
    guard = sanity.TypingGuard() if sanity.enabled("typing_guard") else None
    codes: list[str] = []
    final = {"clicked": False, "page": ""}  # set by finalize once the binding submit button was pressed  # what the mailbox handed out so far: a used code must not be handed out again
    review: Report | None = None
    held_back = 0  # final steps refused because the page did not show the bid

    # The courier gets a fresh tab in the mailbox's browser (same session), opened now in the background while the
    # bid form is filled: the investigators' tab can be left half-navigated by the deadline that stopped them, and
    # a cold mailbox costs minutes when the signing code is waiting (sandbox test run 54c78c38).
    courier_tab: Tab | None = None
    warming = None
    if mail_tab is not None:
        try:
            page = await mail_tab.page.context.new_page()
            courier_tab = Tab(page, {"siteId": mail_tab.site_id, "url": mail_tab.base_url,
                                     "credentials": mail_tab.credentials})
            warming = asyncio.ensure_future(courier_tab.goto(courier_tab.base_url + "/"))
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001  no second tab: fall back to the investigators' one
            courier_tab = mail_tab

    # The control that requested the signing code: clicking it again before a code came back voids the code that is
    # on its way (sandbox run a85be021 lost its signature this way). Recorded when the clerk first asks the mailbox.
    code_request = {"label": None, "searches": 0, "last_click": None}
    omits = {"count": 0}  # omit controls pressed by the clerk (bounded in clerk_guard)

    def _label_of(aid) -> str | None:
        user = clerk.turns[-1]["user"] if clerk.turns else ""
        match = re.search(rf'\[{re.escape(str(aid))}\] [a-z ]*?"([^"]+)"', user)
        return match.group(1).strip() if match else None

    def clerk_guard(action: dict) -> str | None:
        veto = guard(action) if guard is not None else None
        if veto:
            return veto
        # Bounded: after two searches that found nothing the code may really be lost, and a fresh request is allowed.
        label = _label_of(action.get("id")) if action.get("do") == "click" else None
        if (sanity.enabled("single_code_request") and label and code_request["label"]
                and not codes and code_request["searches"] < 2 and label == code_request["label"]):
            return (f'blocked: "{code_request["label"]}" was already used and no code has come back yet. A new '
                    "request makes the code already on its way invalid. Ask the mailbox colleague again (ask_mail) "
                    "and say exactly what to look for: the newest code mail for this tender.")
        if label and bid.decision == "bid" and OMIT_CONTROL.search(label):
            if omits["count"] >= len(bid.omitted) + 1 and deadline - time.time() >= WRAP_UP:
                return (f'blocked: "{label}" would leave out a position that has its values on the bid sheet. Only '
                        "the one position you were stuck on may be left out. Enter this position with its values "
                        "from the bid sheet (all choices with their apply buttons and the amounts in one \"steps\" "
                        "action), then move on.")
            omits["count"] += 1
        if label:
            code_request["last_click"] = label  # read from the page the clerk acted on, before the click happens
        return None

    async def ask_mail(action: dict) -> str:
        if code_request["label"] is None:
            code_request["label"] = code_request["last_click"]  # the control that asked for the code
        code_request["searches"] += 1
        task = str(action.get("task") or "").strip()
        if not task:
            return 'ask_mail needs a "task": say what you need from the mailbox and how to recognise it'
        if courier_tab is None:
            return "there is no mailbox in this run, so nothing can be fetched by mail"
        if warming is not None and not warming.done():
            try:
                await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.shield(warming), 20)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001  the courier opens the page itself then
                pass

        def request() -> str:
            text = f"REQUEST FROM YOUR COLLEAGUE AT THE TENDER PORTAL\n{task}"
            if codes:
                text += ("\n\nANSWERS YOU GAVE EARLIER IN THIS RUN (they are used up: a new request needs a newer "
                         "message)\n" + "\n".join(f"- {code}" for code in codes))
            return text

        system = COURIER.format(site=courier_tab.site_id, url=courier_tab.base_url, reference=reference,
                                actions=ACTIONS_HELP)
        courier = Agent("courier", courier_tab, system, request, deadline=min(deadline, time.time() + MAIL_BUDGET),
                        max_steps=COURIER_STEPS, think=COURIER_THINKS, finish_on_repeat=3)
        outcome = await courier.run()
        answer = str(outcome.get("answer") or "").strip()
        if not answer:
            return ("the mailbox colleague found nothing: " + (outcome.get("summary") or "no result in the time given")
                    + ". Do NOT request a new code yet: a new request makes the current one invalid and costs minutes. "
                    "Ask the colleague again first, saying what to look for (the newest code mail for this tender).")
        codes.append(answer)
        if guard is not None:
            guard.allow(answer)  # read from the mailbox during the run: the clerk may type it
        return f'the mailbox colleague answers: "{answer}"' + (f' ({outcome["summary"]})' if outcome.get("summary") else "")

    async def look() -> Report:
        report = check_review(await tender_tab.observe(), bid, reference)
        if report.unproven and not sanity.enabled("summary_check"):  # switched off: missing evidence only warns
            report = Report(not report.blockers, report.blockers, report.warnings + report.unproven, report.checks)
        return report

    async def check_submission(action: dict) -> str:
        nonlocal review
        review = await look()
        return review.text()

    async def finalize(action: dict) -> str:
        nonlocal review, held_back
        # Navigation, expiry and server validation can invalidate an earlier review, so inspect it again.
        review = await look()
        if review.blockers:
            return review.text() + "\nFinal submission was not pressed."
        if review.unproven:
            # The page does not show the bid, so pressing here would confirm something nobody compared. The clerk
            # is sent to a page that does show it, a bounded number of times and never when time is short.
            short = deadline - time.time() < WRAP_UP
            if held_back < UNPROVEN_REFUSALS and not short:
                held_back += 1
                return review.text() + "\nFinal submission was not pressed."
            print("[submit] final step pressed without full review evidence ("
                  + ("time is short" if short else f"held back {held_back} time(s)") + "): "
                  + " | ".join(review.unproven), flush=True)
        result = await tender_tab.click(action.get("id"))
        # Submitting ends the run and with it the run token: every later model call fails ("expired/unknown run
        # token" in sandbox runs 6da03229, 8184b178, 3c3568bb). So the confirmation is read here, in code, and the
        # clerk stops without another model turn.
        try:
            final["page"] = await asyncio.wait_for(tender_tab.observe(), 20)
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            final["page"] = ""
        final["clicked"] = True
        clerk.deadline = 0  # ends the agent loop before its next model call
        return result

    def heading() -> str:
        left = int(deadline - time.time())
        text = f"YOUR JOB: enter, sign and submit the bid for tender {reference}, then read the confirmation."
        if codes:
            text += "\nCodes from the mailbox so far, oldest first: " + ", ".join(codes)
        if left < WRAP_UP:
            text += (f"\nTIME IS SHORT ({left} s). Enter no further positions: leave out the ones not entered yet if "
                     "the form allows it, go straight to the signature, fetch the code and submit what is entered.")
        return text

    bidder = {"company": context.get("company"), "vat_id": context.get("vat_id"), "email": context.get("email")}
    sheet = bid_sheet(bid)
    system = CLERK.format(site=tender_tab.site_id, url=tender_tab.base_url, brief=brief, reference=reference,
                          bidder=json.dumps(bidder, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1),
                          sheet=json.dumps(sheet, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), actions=ACTIONS_HELP)
    if sanity.enabled("no_guessed_mailbox") and not bidder.get("email"):
        system += ("\nTHE BIDDER'S E-MAIL ADDRESS IS NOT KNOWN YET. If the form asks for it, get it with ask_mail (the "
                   "mailbox colleague can read the address of the mailbox it has open) and type exactly that. Never "
                   "make up an address, not even a plausible one.\n")
    if guard is not None:
        guard.allow(sheet)
        guard.allow(bidder)
        guard.allow(reference)
    clerk = Agent("submit", tender_tab, system, heading,
                  extra={"ask_mail": ask_mail, "check_submission": check_submission, "finalize": finalize}, deadline=deadline,
                  max_steps=CLERK_STEPS, think=CLERK_THINKS, guard=clerk_guard,
                  circle_hint=CLERK_CIRCLE_HINT)
    outcome = await clerk.run()
    receipt = str(outcome.get("answer") or "").strip()
    notes = str(outcome.get("summary") or "")
    if final["clicked"]:  # submitted: the confirmation was read in code, no model turn after the click
        receipt = receipt or final["page"][:1500]
        return {"submitted": True, "receipt": receipt, "notes": notes or "submitted; confirmation read without the model"}
    if not outcome.get("done"):
        notes = (notes + " " if notes else "") + f"stopped after {outcome.get('steps', 0)} steps without a confirmation"
    return {"submitted": bool(outcome.get("done") and receipt), "receipt": receipt, "notes": notes}

"""Local run harness: load the public scouting run into this process and run starter-kit/agent.py on your machine.

Run it with the starter kit's Python (starter-kit/.venv), from any directory:

    python tools/local_run.py --check                       # what gets set, is the model proxy up; runs nothing
    python tools/local_run.py --headed --no-submit          # watch the browsers, stop before the bid form
    python tools/local_run.py --sites ID,ID --log run.log   # only those site agents, output also in run.log
    python tools/local_run.py --no-submit --dump case.json  # keep the case file the agents filled

`atira scout --challenge rfq --env` prints the run's variables as shell lines, the practice logins among them. They
are parsed in memory and put into os.environ, where the agent reads them (run.py `load_run`): never printed, never
written to disk, and read before --log starts. The model proxy is not started here: keep `atira models proxy` running
in another terminal. This file lives outside starter-kit so that it is never packaged.
"""
import argparse
import asyncio
import importlib
import inspect
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import traceback
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

STARTER_KIT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "starter-kit"
SCOUT = ("scout", "--challenge", "rfq", "--env")
SCOUT_TIMEOUT = 30  # seconds; it normally answers in about one
WINDOWS_ATIRA = Path(os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA") or Path.home() / "AppData" / "Local", "atira", "bin", "atira.cmd")
MODEL_DEFAULTS = {"QWEN_BASE_URL": "http://127.0.0.1:8765/qwen/v1", "QWEN_API_KEY": "local"}  # `atira models proxy`

NAME = r"([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)"
ASSIGNMENT = re.compile(rf"^[ \t]*(?:\$env:{NAME}[ \t]*=[ \t]*|(?:export[ \t]+)?{NAME}=)", re.MULTILINE | re.IGNORECASE)
QUOTES = "'" + "".join(map(chr, (0x2018, 0x2019, 0x201A, 0x201B)))  # the four single quotes of PowerShell
POWERSHELL_STRING = re.compile(rf"[{QUOTES}]((?:[^{QUOTES}]|[{QUOTES}]{{2}})*)[{QUOTES}]")
POWERSHELL_DOUBLED = re.compile(rf"[{QUOTES}]([{QUOTES}])")
POSIX_PIECE = re.compile(r"""'([^']*)'|"((?:[^"\\]|\\[\s\S])*)"|\\(.)|([^\s'"\\;]+)""")
POSIX_ESCAPE = re.compile(r'\\([$`"\\]|\n)')  # all a backslash escapes inside double quotes


def parse_env_lines(text: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    r"""The variables that shell lines set, as {name: value}. Comments and anything else are skipped.

    The three syntaxes `atira scout --env` prints: PowerShell `$env:NAME = '...'`, where '' is a literal quote; POSIX
    `export NAME='...'`, where '\'' is one; and `NAME="..."` with backslash escapes. Nothing is expanded: a $ or a
    backtick in a value stays what it is. A value may be empty, and a quoted one may run over several lines.

    PowerShell also reads the typographic single quotes (U+2018, U+2019, U+201A, U+201B) as a quote, so the CLI
    doubles those too: a doubled one is that one character here as well.
    """
    variables, position = {}, 0
    while match := ASSIGNMENT.search(text, position):
        position = match.end()
        if match.group(1):  # PowerShell: one single-quoted string
            quoted = POWERSHELL_STRING.match(text, position)

def merge(self, kind: str, data: dict) -> str:
        """Merge extracted records; returns a one-line account of what they said."""
        told: list[str] = []
        clashes: list[str] = []

        def put(store: dict, key, row: dict, label: str) -> None:
            for name, earlier, later in _merge(store, key, row):
                clashes.append(f"{label} {name}: {earlier!r} on an earlier document, {later!r} on this one")

        if kind == "positions":
            for row in data.get("positions") or []:
                key = _text(row.get("position"))
                if key:
                    put(self.positions, key, row, f"position {key}")
                    told.append(f"{key}: {row.get('quantity')} {row.get('unit') or ''} -> {row.get('requirement_ref')}")
        elif kind == "clarifications":
            for row in data.get("answers") or []:
                key = _text(row.get("number"))
                if key:
                    self.clarifications[key] = row
                    told.append(f"answer {key} ({row.get('timestamp')})")
        elif kind == "revisions":
            for row in data.get("revisions") or []:
                key = _text(row.get("revision"))
                if key:
                    put(self.revisions, key, row, f"revision {key}")
                    told.append(f"{key}: {row.get('status')} ({row.get('date')})")
        elif kind == "requirements":
            revision = _text(data.get("revision")) or ""
            for row in data.get("requirements") or []:
                key = _text(row.get("requirement_ref"))
                if key:
                    put(self.requirements, (revision, key), row, f"requirement {key} in revision {revision or '?'}")
                    told.append(f"{key} in revision {revision or '?'}: bore {row.get('bore_mm')}, stroke {row.get('stroke_mm')}"
                                f"{' (usable travel)' if row.get('stroke_is_usable_travel') else ''}, {row.get('pressure_bar')} bar, "
                                f"{row.get('mounting')}, certification {row.get('certification')}, group {row.get('catalogue_group')}")
        elif kind == "material":
            for row in data.get("materials") or []:
                key = _text(row.get("material_number"))
                if key:
                    put(self.materials, key, row, f"material {key}")
                    told.append(f"{key}: " + ", ".join(f"{name}={value}" for name, value in row.items()
                                                       if value is not None and name not in ("material_number", "description", "number_format")))
        elif kind == "price_conditions":
            key = _text(data.get("material_number"))
            for row in data.get("conditions") or []:
                if key and row.get("scales"):
                    self.conditions.setdefault(key, {})[(str(row.get("valid_from")), str(row.get("valid_to")))] = row
                    told.append(f"{key}: {row.get('valid_from')}..{row.get('valid_to')} {row.get('currency')} "
                                f"per {row.get('price_unit_pieces')} pcs, {len(row['scales'])} scales")
        elif kind == "mail":
            if _text(data.get("mailbox_address")) and "@" in data["mailbox_address"]:
                self.mailbox = data["mailbox_address"].strip()
            for row in data.get("messages") or []:
                key = (str(row.get("sender")), str(row.get("timestamp")), str(row.get("subject")))
                self.messages[key] = row
                blocks = [topic for topic in ("discount",) + TOPICS if row.get(topic)]
                told.append(f"{row.get('subject')} from {row.get('sender')} at {row.get('timestamp')} about "
                            f"{row.get('tender_reference')}: {row.get('topic')} ({', '.join(blocks) or 'no usable data'})")
        self._bump()
        account = "; ".join(told)[:1500] if told else "nothing usable was found in it"

class Ledger:
    def __init__(self):
        self.views: dict[str, str] = {}  # address -> title, in the order of the first visit
        self.queries: list[tuple[str, str]] = []  # (address, text typed), each once
        self.lists: list[ListRun] = []
        self.moves = 0  # browser actions that visibly changed the page
        self.refused: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {}  # question -> (refusals so far, size of the record at the last)

    # ---- written by the agent loop ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def saw(self, page: str) -> None:
        """A page as the agent read it: its first lines carry the address and the title."""
        address = re.match(r"url: (\S+)", page or "")
        if address and address.group(1) not in self.views:
            title = re.search(r"^title: (.*)$", page, re.M)
            self.views[address.group(1)] = title.group(1).strip()[:60] if title else ""

    def typed(self, where: str, text) -> None:
        text = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
        if text and (where, text.casefold()) not in {(place, query.casefold()) for place, query in self.queries}:
            self.queries.append((where, text))

    def followed(self, run: dict | None) -> None:
        """How `Tab.collect` ended (its `last_collect`)."""
        if run:
            self.lists.append(ListRun(str(run.get("where", "")), str(run.get("control", "")),
                                      int(run.get("pages") or 0), bool(run.get("capped"))))

    def moved(self) -> None:
        self.moves += 1

    # ---- read by the gate ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def size(self) -> int:
        return len(self.views) + len(self.queries) + len(self.lists) + self.moves

    def incomplete(self) -> list[ListRun]:
        """Lists whose last run stopped at the page limit. Following the same control to its end clears it."""
        latest: dict[str, ListRun] = {}
        for run in self.lists:
            latest[run.control] = run
        return [run for run in latest.values() if run.capped]

    def report(self) -> str:
        pages = [f'"{title}" {_short(address)}' if title else _short(address) for address, title in self.views.items()]
        typed = [f'"{text[:60]}" at {_short(where)}' for where, text in self.queries]
        lists = [f'"{run.control}" from {_short(run.where)}: {run.pages} page(s), '
                 + ("STOPPED AT THE PAGE LIMIT" if run.capped else "to the end") for run in self.lists]
        return "\n".join(f"- {label} ({len(items)}): " + ("; ".join(items[-SHOWN:]) or "none") for label, items in (
            ("pages opened", pages), ("text typed into search and other fields", typed),
            ("lists followed page by page", lists)))

    def gate(self, question: str, status: str) -> str | None:
        """None when the question may be closed as `status`, else what is missing."""
        times, size = self.refused.get(question, (0, -1))
        if times >= LIMIT:
            return None
        cut_short = self.incomplete()
        if cut_short:
            self.refused[question] = (times + 1, self.size())
            return ("not closed: " + "; ".join(f'the list you followed with "{run.control}" from {_short(run.where)} '
                                               f"stopped at its limit of {run.pages} page(s) with more pages left"
                                               for run in cut_short)
                    + ". An incomplete list proves neither that everything is filed nor that something is absent. "
                      "Collect the rest (collect continues from the page you are on; a higher max_pages reads "
                      "further), file it with keep, then answer again.")
        if status != "absent" or (times and self.size() > size):
            return None
        self.refused[question] = (times + 1, self.size())
        lead = "not closed: nothing new was searched since the last check. " if times else "not closed yet. "
        return (lead + "Absent needs a full search, and this is what you actually did on this website:\n"
                + self.report()
                + "\nA search without hits covers only that search term in that place. Before you answer absent "
                  "again: open every section, folder or list of this website that could hold it and is not in the "
                  "record, search with another term from the case file (an identifier, a shorter form, a "
                  "describing word), and follow paged lists to their end. If the record already covers all of "
                  "that, make one more different search to confirm, then answer again.")

class Ledger:
    def __init__(self):
        self.views: dict[str, str] = {}  # address -> title, in the order of the first visit
        self.queries: list[tuple[str, str]] = []  # (address, text typed), each once
        self.lists: list[ListRun] = []
        self.moves = 0  # browser actions that visibly changed the page
        self.refused: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {}  # question -> (refusals so far, size of the record at the last)

    # ---- written by the agent loop ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def saw(self, page: str) -> None:
        """A page as the agent read it: its first lines carry the address and the title."""
        address = re.match(r"url: (\S+)", page or "")
        if address and address.group(1) not in self.views:
            title = re.search(r"^title: (.*)$", page, re.M)
            self.views[address.group(1)] = title.group(1).strip()[:60] if title else ""

    def typed(self, where: str, text) -> None:
        text = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
        if text and (where, text.casefold()) not in {(place, query.casefold()) for place, query in self.queries}:
            self.queries.append((where, text))

    def followed(self, run: dict | None) -> None:
        """How `Tab.collect` ended (its `last_collect`)."""
        if run:
            self.lists.append(ListRun(str(run.get("where", "")), str(run.get("control", "")),
                                      int(run.get("pages") or 0), bool(run.get("capped"))))

    def moved(self) -> None:
        self.moves += 1

    # ---- read by the gate ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def size(self) -> int:
        return len(self.views) + len(self.queries) + len(self.lists) + self.moves

    def incomplete(self) -> list[ListRun]:
        """Lists whose last run stopped at the page limit. Following the same control to its end clears it."""
        latest: dict[str, ListRun] = {}
        for run in self.lists:
            latest[run.control] = run
        return [run for run in latest.values() if run.capped]

    def report(self) -> str:
        pages = [f'"{title}" {_short(address)}' if title else _short(address) for address, title in self.views.items()]
        typed = [f'"{text[:60]}" at {_short(where)}' for where, text in self.queries]
        lists = [f'"{run.control}" from {_short(run.where)}: {run.pages} page(s), '
                 + ("STOPPED AT THE PAGE LIMIT" if run.capped else "to the end") for run in self.lists]
        return "\n".join(f"- {label} ({len(items)}): " + ("; ".join(items[-SHOWN:]) or "none") for label, items in (
            ("pages opened", pages), ("text typed into search and other fields", typed),
            ("lists followed page by page", lists)))

    def gate(self, question: str, status: str) -> str | None:
        """None when the question may be closed as `status`, else what is missing."""
        times, size = self.refused.get(question, (0, -1))
        if times >= LIMIT:
            return None
        cut_short = self.incomplete()
        if cut_short:
            self.refused[question] = (times + 1, self.size())
            return ("not closed: " + "; ".join(f'the list you followed with "{run.control}" from {_short(run.where)} '
                                               f"stopped at its limit of {run.pages} page(s) with more pages left"
                                               for run in cut_short)
                    + ". An incomplete list proves neither that everything is filed nor that something is absent. "
                      "Collect the rest (collect continues from the page you are on; a higher max_pages reads "
                      "further), file it with keep, then answer again.")
        if status != "absent" or (times and self.size() > size):
            return None
        self.refused[question] = (times + 1, self.size())
        lead = "not closed: nothing new was searched since the last check. " if times else "not closed yet. "
        return (lead + "Absent needs a full search, and this is what you actually did on this website:\n"
                + self.report()
                + "\nA search without hits covers only that search term in that place. Before you answer absent "
                  "again: open every section, folder or list of this website that could hold it and is not in the "
                  "record, search with another term from the case file (an identifier, a shorter form, a "
                  "describing word), and follow paged lists to their end. If the record already covers all of "
                  "that, make one more different search to confirm, then answer again.")

"""The "steps" action: a chain of label-addressed form steps across page reloads in one model turn (worker.py).

In every clean sandbox run the bid clerk needed 40-46 turns (3.5-4.5 min) for the configurator, one choice and one
"apply" click per turn, because a page reload drops the rest of a turn's actions. These tests use an invented
cascading form whose element ids change on every reload."""
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import patch

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

import llm  # noqa: E402
from worker import Agent, find_control  # noqa: E402


class CascadeForm:
    """Choose a size, apply; choose a finish, apply; type a price; continue. Ids shift with every page."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.base_url = "http://form.test"
        self.page = SimpleNamespace(url=self.base_url, main_frame=SimpleNamespace(evaluate=self._alive))
        self.document, self.document_source = "", ""
        self.stage, self.offset, self.values = 0, 0, {}

    async def _alive(self, script):
        return True

    def take_events(self):
        return []

    def ids(self):
        return {name: str(index + self.offset) for index, name in enumerate(("size", "apply", "finish", "price", "next"))}

    async def observe(self):
        i = self.ids()
        lines = [f"url: {self.base_url}/position", "title: Position 1",
                 f'[{i["size"]}] select "Size" options(* = selected): "S"; "M"; "L"',
                 f'[{i["apply"]}] button "Apply choice"']
        if self.stage >= 1:
            lines.append(f'[{i["finish"]}] select "Finish" options(* = selected): "matt"; "gloss"')
        if self.stage >= 2:
            lines.append(f'[{i["price"]}] input "Unit price" value=""')
            lines.append(f'[{i["next"]}] button "Continue"')
        return "\n".join(lines)

    async def select(self, aid, value):
        i = self.ids()
        key = "size" if str(aid) == i["size"] else "finish" if str(aid) == i["finish"] else None
        if key is None:
            return f"[{aid}] is not a list on this page"
        self.values[key] = value
        return f'selected "{value}"'

    async def click(self, aid):
        i = self.ids()
        if str(aid) == i["apply"]:
            self.stage, self.offset = self.stage + 1, self.offset + 10  # the page reloads: new ids
            return "clicked; the page reloaded"
        if str(aid) == i["next"]:
            self.values["continued"] = True
            return "clicked; next position"
        return f"[{aid}] not found"

    async def fill(self, aid, text, enter=False):
        if str(aid) != self.ids()["price"]:
            return f"[{aid}] not found"
        self.values["price"] = text
        return f"filled [{aid}]"

"apply" click per turn, because a page reload drops the rest of a turn's actions. These tests use an invented
cascading form whose element ids change on every reload."""
import sys

class CascadeForm:
    """Choose a size, apply; choose a finish, apply; type a price; continue. Ids shift with every page."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.base_url = "http://form.test"
        self.page = SimpleNamespace(url=self.base_url, main_frame=SimpleNamespace(evaluate=self._alive))
        self.document, self.document_source = "", ""
        self.stage, self.offset, self.values = 0, 0, {}

    async def _alive(self, script):
        return True

    def take_events(self):
        return []

    def ids(self):
        return {name: str(index + self.offset) for index, name in enumerate(("size", "apply", "finish", "price", "next"))}

    async def observe(self):
        i = self.ids()
        lines = [f"url: {self.base_url}/position", "title: Position 1",
                 f'[{i["size"]}] select "Size" options(* = selected): "S"; "M"; "L"',
                 f'[{i["apply"]}] button "Apply choice"']
        if self.stage >= 1:
            lines.append(f'[{i["finish"]}] select "Finish" options(* = selected): "matt"; "gloss"')
        if self.stage >= 2:
            lines.append(f'[{i["price"]}] input "Unit price" value=""')
            lines.append(f'[{i["next"]}] button "Continue"')
        return "\n".join(lines)

    async def select(self, aid, value):
        i = self.ids()
        key = "size" if str(aid) == i["size"] else "finish" if str(aid) == i["finish"] else None
        if key is None:
            return f"[{aid}] is not a list on this page"
        self.values[key] = value
        return f'selected "{value}"'

    async def click(self, aid):
        i = self.ids()
        if str(aid) == i["apply"]:
            self.stage, self.offset = self.stage + 1, self.offset + 10  # the page reloads: new ids
            return "clicked; the page reloaded"
        if str(aid) == i["next"]:
            self.values["continued"] = True
            return "clicked; next position"
        return f"[{aid}] not found"

    async def fill(self, aid, text, enter=False):
        if str(aid) != self.ids()["price"]:
            return f"[{aid}] not found"
        self.values["price"] = text
        return f"filled [{aid}]"

from unittest.mock import patch

import llm  # noqa: E402

    def test_the_agent_looking_at_a_material_gets_the_question_about_its_data(self):
        agent.POOLS["erp"] = ["erp", "erp#2"]

        self.assertEqual([q for q, _ in questions_for_site("mail", questions)], ["topic:condition_rules", "condition_group:K-1"])
        self.assertEqual([q for q, _ in questions_for_site("mail#2", questions)], ["topic:fx_fixing", "fx:F-1"])

class FetchedAhead(unittest.TestCase):
    def case(self):
        return CaseFile("brief", {"tender_reference": "T-0001", "scenario_date": "2031-03-10T09:00:00+00:00",
                                  "authorized_senders": {"fx_fixing": "treasury", "packaging_tariffs": "shipping"}})

    def test_a_record_is_asked_for_from_the_start_for_every_sender_the_brief_names(self):
        case = self.case()
        self.assertEqual([qid for qid, _ in case.prefetch()], ["topic:packaging_tariffs", "topic:fx_fixing"])
        self.assertNotIn("topic:fx_fixing", [qid for qid, _ in case.questions()])  # it never holds the investigation up

        self.assertIn("closed as absent", case.answer("topic:packaging_tariffs", "absent", "searched both folders"))

                                          "subject": "FX", "tender_reference": "T-0001-A", "topic": "fx_fixing",

        team = Team(case, ["erp"], time.time() + 5)
        watching = asyncio.create_task(team.watch())
        await asyncio.sleep(0.7)
        self.assertFalse(team.finished.is_set())  # a filed document is still being read
        case.pending = 0
        await asyncio.wait_for(watching, 2)
        self.assertTrue(team.finished.is_set())

    async def test_a_further_agent_starts_only_when_a_share_is_its_own(self):
        class Case:
            version, pending, open = 0, 0, []
            def questions(self):
                return self.open
            async def wait_change(self, seen, timeout):
                await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
                return self.version != seen
        case = Case()
        agent.POOLS["erp"] = ["erp", "erp#2"]
        team = Team(case, ["erp", "erp#2", "mail"], time.time() + 5)
        waiting = asyncio.create_task(team.wait_for_work("erp#2"))
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
        self.assertFalse(waiting.done())
        case.open, case.version = [("material:REQ-1", "m")], 1  # one share: it goes to the website's first agent
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
        self.assertFalse(waiting.done())
        case.open, case.version = case.open + [("material:REQ-2", "m")], 2
        self.assertTrue(await asyncio.wait_for(waiting, 2))

    async def test_an_agent_without_work_is_held_before_the_model_is_asked(self):
        asked, held = [], []

        async def model(messages, **kwargs):
            asked.append(1)
            return {"thought": f"look {len(asked)}", "actions": [{"do": "wait"}]}

        async def idle(why):
            held.append(why)
            return None

        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", model), patch("worker.asyncio.sleep", new=lambda s: asyncio.sleep(0)):
            outcome = await Agent("erp", CascadeForm(), "system", lambda: "job", idle=idle, work=lambda: False).run()
        self.assertEqual((len(asked), held), (3, ["no work"]))  # its first turns (login, consent), then no more calls
        self.assertTrue(outcome["done"])


class FormChain(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_the_page_is_not_read_again_before_a_field_that_is_only_typed_into(self):
        class Counting(CascadeForm):
            reads = 0
            async def observe(self):
                self.reads += 1
                return await super().observe()
        form = Counting()
        result = await Agent("clerk", form, "system", lambda: "job")._steps(
            STEPS[:4] + [{"field": "Unit price", "value": "1,00"}, {"field": "Unit price", "value": "123,45"}, {"press": "Continue"}])
        self.assertIn("ran all 7 steps", result)
        self.assertEqual(form.values, {"size": "M", "finish": "matt", "price": "123,45", "continued": True})
        self.assertEqual(form.reads, 6)  # before step 1, after each of the 3 presses, after each of the 2 choices

    async def test_a_press_that_brought_an_error_message_is_remembered(self):
        clerk = Agent("clerk", CascadeForm(), "system", lambda: "job")
        before = 'url: x\n[4] button "Add line"\n[5] button "Continue"'
        self.assertEqual(clerk.note_press("Add line", before, before + "\n(alert) not possible in this step"),
                         ["(alert) not possible in this step"])
        clerk.note_press("Add line", before, before + "\n(alert) not possible in this step")
        self.assertEqual(clerk.note_press("Continue", before, before), [])
        self.assertEqual(clerk.press_notes(), "- pressing \"Add line\" brought the message '(alert) not possible in this step' (2 times)")


class LeavingOut(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_a_further_position_is_refused_twice_and_then_left_out_so_that_the_bid_is_still_signed(self):
        # run 012496d3: refused 90 times in a row on its second stuck position, step limit reached, never signed
        omit = {"thought": "", "actions": [{"do": "click", "id": 21}]}
        script = Script(submit=[omit] * 5 + [done(summary="stopped")])
        tender = FakeTab("tender", 'Position\n[21] button "Position auslassen (Teilpunkte)"\n[24] button "Weiter"')
        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", script):
            await submit.submit_bid(tender, FakeTab("mail"), a_bid(), CONTEXT, "THE BRIEF", time.time() + 900)
        # a_bid() has one position the calculator left out: two omits pass, two are refused, the fifth passes
        self.assertEqual(tender.done.count(("click", 21)), 3)
        self.assertIn("blocked", script.turns("submit")[3]["user"])
        self.assertIn("blocked", script.turns("submit")[4]["user"])
        self.assertNotIn("blocked", script.turns("submit")[5]["user"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Specialized investigators wake only for questions their portal can answer."""
import asyncio
import sys
import time
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

import agent  # noqa: E402
from agent import Team, questions_for_site  # noqa: E402


class FakeCase:
    def __init__(self):
        self.version = 0
        self.pending = 0
        self.news = {}
        self.open_questions = [("mailbox", "Find the sales mailbox.")]
        self.changed = asyncio.Event()

    def questions(self):
        return list(self.open_questions)

    async def wait_change(self, seen, timeout):
        """As CaseFile.wait_change: clear first, then wait, so an old signal does not count as a new change."""
        if self.version == seen:
            self.changed.clear()
            try:
                await asyncio.wait_for(self.changed.wait(), timeout)
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                return False
        return self.version != seen

    def update(self, question):
        self.open_questions.append(question)
        self.version += 1
        self.changed.set()


class QuestionRouting(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        agent.SITE_ROLES.clear()
        agent.RELEASED.clear()

    tearDown = setUp

    def test_erp_and_mail_receive_only_resolvable_questions(self):
        questions = [
            ("positions", "Find tender positions."),
            ("material:REQ-1", "Find a matching ERP material."),
            ("data:MAT-1", "Find missing ERP data."),
            ("discount", "Find discount approval."),
            ("reserve:REQ-2", "Find technical release."),
        ]

        self.assertEqual([qid for qid, _ in questions_for_site("erp", questions)],
                         ["material:REQ-1", "data:MAT-1"])
        self.assertEqual([qid for qid, _ in questions_for_site("mail", questions)],
                         ["discount", "reserve:REQ-2"])
        self.assertEqual(questions_for_site("new-portal", questions), questions)

    def test_routing_follows_the_roles_read_from_the_brief_not_the_site_names(self):
        """The private dataset uses other site names (brief: other software, layout and site names)."""
        questions = [("positions", "p"), ("material:REQ-1", "m"), ("discount", "d"), ("reserve:REQ-2", "r")]
        try:
            agent.SITE_ROLES.update({"erp": "warenwirtschaft", "mail": "postfach"})
            self.assertEqual([q for q, _ in questions_for_site("warenwirtschaft", questions)], ["material:REQ-1"])
            self.assertEqual([q for q, _ in questions_for_site("postfach", questions)], ["discount", "reserve:REQ-2"])
            # a site that merely contains "mail" in its name but is not the mailbox gets everything
            self.assertEqual(questions_for_site("mailing-list-portal", questions), questions)
        finally:
            agent.SITE_ROLES.clear()


    async def test_a_routed_question_left_open_is_offered_to_every_agent(self):
        """The private dataset may split facts differently: here the packaging tariff sits in the ERP, so the mail
        agent finishes without it. The question must reach the ERP agent instead of staying with nobody."""
        case = FakeCase()
        case.open_questions = [("packaging_tariff:PKG-9", "the tariff"), ("material:REQ-1", "the material")]
        case._bump = lambda: (setattr(case, "version", case.version + 1), case.changed.set())
        team = Team(case, ["erp", "mail"], time.time() + 5)
        try:
            agent.SITE_ROLES.update({"erp": "erp", "mail": "mail"})
            erp_waiting = asyncio.create_task(team.hook("erp")("done"))  # ERP finished its own question set
            await asyncio.sleep(0.02)
            self.assertIn("material:REQ-1", agent.RELEASED)  # ERP went idle with it open and nothing being read
            mail_waiting = asyncio.create_task(team.hook("mail")("done"))  # mail finished without the tariff
            news = await asyncio.wait_for(erp_waiting, 2)
            self.assertIn("packaging_tariff:PKG-9", news or "")
            self.assertIn("packaging_tariff:PKG-9", [q for q, _ in questions_for_site("erp", case.questions())])
            mail_waiting.cancel()
        finally:
            agent.SITE_ROLES.clear()
            agent.RELEASED.clear()

    def test_nothing_is_released_while_documents_are_still_being_read(self):
        case = FakeCase()
        case.open_questions = [("packaging_tariff:PKG-9", "the tariff")]
        case.pending = 1
        Team(case, ["mail"], time.time() + 5).release("mail", {"packaging_tariff:PKG-9"})
        self.assertEqual(agent.RELEASED, set())

    async def test_erp_idle_hook_ignores_new_mail_questions(self):
        case = FakeCase()
        team = Team(case, ["erp"], time.time() + 5)
        hook = team.hook("erp")
        waiting = asyncio.create_task(hook("done"))
        await asyncio.sleep(0)

        case.update(("discount", "Find discount approval."))
        await asyncio.sleep(0.02)
        self.assertFalse(waiting.done())

        case.update(("material:REQ-1", "Find a matching ERP material."))
        self.assertIn("material:REQ-1", await waiting)

web.description:
# Towards a science of scaling agent systems: When and why agent systems work
Through a controlled evaluation of 180 agent configurations, we derive the first quantitative scaling principles for AI agent systems, revealing that multi-agent coordination dramatically improves performance on parallelizable tasks but degrades it on sequential ones; we also introduce a predictive model that identifies the optimal architecture for 87% of unseen tasks.

## Quick links
Unlike isolated predictions, agents must navigate sustained, multi-step interactions where a single error can cascade throughout a workflow.

## Results: The myth of "more agents"
This data highlights that while adding agents can drive massive gains in parallelizable tasks, it can often lead to diminishing returns — or even performance drops — in more sequential workflows.

_Task-specific performance showing that multi-agent coordination yields substantial gains on parallelizable tasks like Finance-Agent (+81%) while degrading performance on sequential tasks like PlanCraft (-70%)._

### The sequential penalty
Conversely, on tasks requiring strict sequential reasoning (like planning in PlanCraft), every multi-agent variant we tested degraded performance by 39-70%.

## Architecture as a safety feature
We measured _error amplification_, the rate at which a mistake by one agent propagates to the final result.

_Comprehensive metrics across architectures reveal that centralized systems achieve the best balance between success rate and error containment, while independent multi-agent systems amplify errors by up to 17.2x._

We found that independent multi-agent systems (agents working in parallel without talking) amplified errors by 17.2x.

"""One tab at a time passes a website's entrance (browser_env.Entrance, Tab.enter).

Local run with five ERP tabs in one browser session: the session ended, every tab stood in front of the login form
at once, and each tab that loaded the form spoilt the one another tab was filling in ("the form expired" for 55 s).
The website here is invented."""
import asyncio
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

import browser_env  # noqa: E402
from browser_env import AT_LOGIN_JS, Entrance, Tab  # noqa: E402


class Site:
    """A website whose session is shared by its tabs: logged out, every page is the login form."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.logged_in, self.logins, self.at_once, self.worst = False, 0, 0, 0


class Page:
    def __init__(self, site: Site, url: str):
        self.site, self.url = site, url
        self.frames = [SimpleNamespace(evaluate=self.evaluate)]
        self.main_frame = self.frames[0]

    def on(self, event, handler):
        pass

    async def evaluate(self, script, *args):
        return not self.site.logged_in if script == AT_LOGIN_JS else None


class SiteTab(Tab):
    def __init__(self, site: Site, url: str = "http://shop.test/record/7"):
        super().__init__(Page(site, url), {"siteId": "shop", "url": "http://shop.test", "credentials": {"password": "x"}})
        self.site, self.opened = site, []

    async def goto(self, url):
        self.opened.append(url)
        self.page.url = url
        return f"opened {url}"

    async def login(self):
        self.site.at_once += 1
        self.site.worst = max(self.site.worst, self.site.at_once)
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
        self.site.logged_in, self.site.logins = True, self.site.logins + 1
        self.site.at_once -= 1
        return "entered the credentials"


class OneTabAtATime(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        browser_env.ENTRANCES.clear()

    async def test_three_tabs_in_front_of_the_login_form_log_in_once(self):
        site = Site()
        first, second, third = SiteTab(site), SiteTab(site), SiteTab(site, "http://shop.test/login?back=%2Fsearch")
        entering = [asyncio.create_task(tab.enter()) for tab in (first, second, third)]
        await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
        self.assertEqual((site.logins, site.worst), (1, 1))
        self.assertEqual([task.done() for task in entering], [True, False, False])  # the others wait for the first
        await first.enter()  # the turns in which the first tab passes what follows the login
        await first.enter()
        await first.enter()
        await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.gather(*entering), 2)

perf: several model-directed tabs on the ERP and the mailbox; mail records fetched ahead; investigation ends when nothing is open

Sandbox run 9902e32b (100 in 6.3 min) spent 217 s investigating: the ERP agent read its
materials one click per turn (58 turns in a row), the mailbox agent one kind of record
after another (36 turns), and the run waited for every agent's closing turn.

- agent.py: the ERP and the mailbox each get up to 5 agents, every one in a tab of its
  own in that website's browser; the open questions are shared out among them (one

  call until a share is theirs.

  run after a page change, so one reply can open and file several records; the "steps"
  chain reads the page once per reload instead of before every field.
- browser_env.py: one tab at a time passes a website's entrance (login and what follows),
  and an idle agent keeps its session in use.
- submit.py: leaving out a further position is refused twice, then allowed (run 012496d3
  was refused 90 times and never signed); the clerk is shown which presses brought an
  error; finalize runs the checklist itself.
- The websites are opened and logged in to while the model reads the brief.

Local run on the practice websites: the same bid as the 100 runs, investigation 132 s
with 12 agents. 356 unit tests pass (18 new).

# Team QuoteCraft: who owns what

EHL Grand Finale 2026 · Atira challenge "From RFQ to bid". Updated 11 Oct 2026, 04:00 UTC (06:00 Berlin).

## Where we stand (11 Oct, 04:00 UTC)

| | |
|---|---|
| **Final package** (latest passed submission) | **sub_973a02b5** = test run 4876a0ad promoted by the organisers = `maria/cost` **9105e5e** (100, **$0.164**, 8.4 min). ⚠️ **Known risk:** the same package scored **0** in 012496d3 (clerk omit loop, see problem P1). Fix dba5e72 is in test |
| **Leaderboard** | **#7**, 100, $0.164, 8:21. Ranking between equal quality = **cost × time** (fits every pair on the board): we are at 1.37; #6 AdminRights 1.16, #5 EliTUM 1.11, #4 error404 0.83. The top three are at 0.03-0.25 |
| **Promotions** | The organisers promote our better test runs to submissions themselves (44a626ef, then 1b83cba3 + 9902e32b, then 4876a0ad). **A test run can become our final package**: only test code we would be happy to see in the final |
| **Branches** | `maria/escalation` (all robustness fixes + clerk fixes, last dba5e72) → `maria/cost` (+ cost cuts, last 8e19c98). Neither merged to main; main (d72deb8) has none of these fixes |
| **Winners** | Picked on the private dataset first, then public, then elegance. Robustness first, then cost × time |

### Open problems

| # | Problem | Status |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | **Clerk loops on the bid form** (d3ca14df, 8a2e1426, 012496d3: all 0). Root cause found: the `steps` chain reported the form's "position added" notice as an error, the clerk entered the position again, the form refused; the omit cap of fc54a43 then turned the refused omit into a loop | 🟨 dba5e72: notice reported neutrally, "a saved position may empty its fields: go on", one more omit after each circle hint. 3 sandbox runs running (7dbf1540, bf29711e, 608c82d7) |
| P2 | **Sandbox infrastructure**: tender-portal / mail outages, platform failures, model overload (8a2e1426 mail down, d8fdffff platform failure) | Not ours. Browser failover (288c88c) helps when only one browser is affected |
| P3 | **Cost**: ERP is 46% of all input tokens (828k of 1.8M in 4876a0ad, ~14k per call); prompt caching is unreliable (local probe: identical prompts mostly 0 cached) | 🟨 history cut done (9105e5e, $0.31 → $0.16); page-text trimming next |
| P4 | **Time**: investigation 220-370 s, form + TAN 160-280 s | ⬜ start agents during the context call, ERP sooner |
| P5 | Scanned PDFs (no OCR) on the private dataset | ⬜ optional |

### Next tasks

| Task | Owner | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Confirm the clerk fix dba5e72 in the sandbox (3 runs) | Maria | 🟨 running |
| Trimming: measured on local traces, the old history (not the page text) is what fills ERP calls → history cap 41cfde5, 2 sandbox runs | Maria | 🟨 running |
| Decide the final package: resubmit `maria/cost` with dba5e72 once confirmed (or let a promoted run replace it) | **Maria + Vamshidhar** | ⬜ needs the go |
| Speed: agents start during the context call; ERP starts sooner | Maria | ⬜ |
| Pitch: story of the architecture, the fair-play design, the cost × time work | Iga, Ravindra | ⬜ |

## Owners

| Role | Owner | Focus | Done when |
|---|---|---|---|
| Build lead + verification | Maria | Local runs, scoring against our reference answer, sandbox test runs, merging branches, OpenAI vs Qwen for fact extraction | A sandbox test run scores ≥ 60 in < 15 min |

Author: Maria Zyskowska <mari2605006@outlook.com>

    fix(clerk): a page notice after a press may be a confirmation; a clerk caught in circles again may omit once more
    
    Run 012496d3: the steps chain ended with the form's add-position button and reported the page's new notice as
    something to fix; the clerk entered the same position again, the form refused, it got stuck, and after its one
    allowed omit the refused omit on the next stuck position became a loop. Now the notice is reported neutrally, the
    clerk is told a saved position may empty its fields, and one more omit is allowed after each new circle hint.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

diff --git a/starter-kit/submit.py b/starter-kit/submit.py
index fa5f2e8..bd68830 100644
--- a/starter-kit/submit.py
+++ b/starter-kit/submit.py
@@ -36,8 +36,10 @@ CLERK_CIRCLE_HINT = (
     "fails too, leave out THIS ONE position with the form's explicit way of omitting a position. Every position "
     "after it has its values on the bid sheet: enter each of them normally, then sign. A signed bid keeps the points "
     "of every position it has; an unsigned one scores nothing.")
-# Leaving out a priced position costs its points, so the clerk may do it once (the position it is stuck on) on top of
-# the positions the calculator left out, unless time is short. Matched on the omit control's label in a few languages.
+# Leaving out a priced position costs its points, so the clerk may do it only for a position it is stuck on: once at
+# the start, and once more each time it is caught going in circles again (run 012496d3: a single allowance for the
+# whole run made a clerk stuck on a second position loop on the refused omit). The positions the calculator left out
+# and a short time are always allowed. Matched on the omit control's label in a few languages.
 OMIT_CONTROL = re.compile(r"auslass|weglass|omit|leave out|skip position|nicht anbieten", re.I)
 # How often the final step is held back because the page does not show the bid (preflight "unproven"). The wait is
 # bounded: a signed bid scores, an unsigned one does not.
@@ -79,6 +81,9 @@ Reading the bid sheet
   This includes a configurator where each choice must be applied before the next one appears: put every choice
   and its apply button, in order, into the same "steps" action, then the amounts and the button that moves on.
   You know every value from the bid; you do not need to see each list first.
+- A position is entered once. When the form saves it, it may list it, show a short confirmation and empty its
+  fields for a further line: then go on with the control that moves to the next position or step, and do not
+  enter the same position again.
 
 {actions}
 One more action:
@@ -200,7 +205,7 @@ async def submit_bid(tender_tab: Tab, mail_tab: Tab | None, bid: Bid, context: d
     # The control that requested the signing code: clicking it again before a code came back voids the code that is
     # on its way (sandbox run a85be021 lost its signature this way). Recorded when the clerk first asks the mailbox.
     code_request = {"label": None, "searches": 0, "last_click": None}
-    omits = {"count": 0}  # omit controls pressed by the clerk (bounded in clerk_guard)
+    omits = {"count": 0, "hints": 0}  # omit controls pressed, and the clerk's circle hints at the last one
 
     def _label_of(aid) -> str | None:
         user = clerk.turns[-1]["user"] if clerk.turns else ""
@@ -219,12 +224,15 @@ async def submit_bid(tender_tab: Tab, mail_tab: Tab | None, bid: Bid, context: d
                     "request makes the code already on its way invalid. Ask the mailbox colleague again (ask_mail) "
                     "and say exactly what to look for: the newest code mail for this tender.")
         if label and bid.decision == "bid" and OMIT_CONTROL.search(label):
-            if omits["count"] >= len(bid.omitted) + 1 and deadline - time.time() >= WRAP_UP:
+            stuck_again = clerk.circle_hints > omits["hints"]  # caught going in circles since the last omit
+            if (omits["count"] >= len(bid.omitted) + 1 and not stuck_again
+                    and deadline - time.time() >= WRAP_UP):
                 return (f'blocked: "{label}" would leave out a position that has its values on the bid sheet. Only '
                         "the one position you were stuck on may be left out. Enter this position with its values "
                         "from the bid sheet (all choices with their apply buttons and the amounts in one \"steps\" "
                         "action), then move on.")
             omits["count"] += 1
+            omits["hints"] = clerk.circle_hints
         if label:
             code_request["last_click"] = label  # read from the page the clerk acted on, before the click happens
         return None
